races.race_name: Irish Stallion Farms EBF Nursery Handicap (Birdcatcher Series)

runners.name: Banks Of The Boyne
runners.spotlight: Showed little on his first two starts; was able to dictate in a 6f Fairyhouse maiden and gave a much-improved display to take second; no match for a Joseph O'Brien-trained winner at Galway (I Ready back in fourth); might not cope with Mr Montauk now.
runners.comment: No match for a Joseph O'Brien-trained winner at Galway, might not cope with Mr Montauk now

runners.name: Away And Gone
runners.spotlight: Failed to run to market expectations when favourite on debut at Cork (5f, soft); better effort at Navan (5f, good) when fourth of nine; struggled in a conditions race last time; stable also represented by Oisin Murphy's mount Alrashdeyah.
runners.comment: Struggled in a conditions race last time, stable also represented by Alrashdeyah

runners.name: Shesthedevil
runners.spotlight: Ordinary form in maidens at Listowel and Down Royal; stepped up considerably on those runs to win at Navan on a superb day for her trainer; sights are lowered considerably now following a Listed bid at Naas.
runners.comment: Navan maiden winner, sights are lowered considerably now following a Listed bid

runners.name: Alrashdeyah
runners.spotlight: Oisin Murphy booked; hard to take positives from her maiden form; very poor at Bellewstown when last of eight; hood used then is now discarded.
runners.comment: Oisin Murphy booked, hard to take positives from her maiden form, poor at Bellewstown

runners.name: Mr Montauk
runners.spotlight: Three qualifying runs over 5f, all within the space of three weeks in April/May; sent off second-favourite for a 5f Down Royal nursery last month, got outpaced and then hampered at a crucial stage when staying on; chased home a strongly fancied rival from the Paddy Twomey stable at Sligo, good chance he can go one better.
runners.comment: Chased home a strongly fancied rival at Sligo, good chance he can go one better

runners.name: I Ready
runners.spotlight: Reacted well to the addition of cheekpieces when a narrow winner from Seven Nation Army in a C&D nursery; raised 7lb and was almost 2l behind Battle Of The Boyne when fourth in the Galway race won by Seven Nation Army; blinkered this time.
runners.comment: Went up 7lb for narrow C&D win, almost 2l behind Battle Of The Boyne at Galway

runners.name: High Morals
runners.spotlight: Failed to run to expectations when favourite for a C&D maiden on debut; best of his three outings was over 1m at Bellewstown; this trip may prove inadequate.
runners.comment: Best of his three maiden outings was over 1m, this trip may prove inadequate

runners.name: Celestial Crown
runners.spotlight: All four runs over 5f; best display on debut when second to the smart Velozee (third in last Sunday's Phoenix Stakes) on soft ground at Cork; subsequent form on good going raises doubts.
runners.comment: Best display on debut when second to the smart Velozee, subsequent form raises doubts

runners.name: Howlin Wolf
runners.spotlight: Long odds for first two starts and soundly beaten; Bellewstown fourth was a step in the right direction; others have more convincing claims
runners.comment: Bellewstown fourth was a step in the right direction, others have more persuasive claims

races.race_name: Irish EBF Median Sires Series Maiden (IRE Incentive Race)

runners.name: The Pipeman
runners.spotlight: Showed strong potential for success in a race like this with a debut second in a 17-runner contest at Navan; winner Shesthedevil will put that form to the test in the opening nursery.
runners.comment: Showed strong potential for success in a race like this with a debut second at Navan

runners.name: Coincidenza
runners.spotlight: E25,000 yearling, cost 200,000gns at Tatts Craven Breeze-Up in April; by Ten Sovereigns filly; dam 6f AW 2yo winner, out of Listed-placed middle-distance winner by Oasis Dream.
runners.comment: Ten Sovereigns filly, dam a 6f AW 2yo winner, fetched 200,000 gns at a Breeze Up sale
runners.owner: Medallion Racing 2020 LLC/B Fowler/Reeves T'bred/ S I Weston

runners.name: Heart Of You
runners.spotlight: Ran respectably first time out in a 7f maiden at Galway; open to improvement; hard to be sure if drop to 6f will be a help or a hindrance.
runners.comment: Ran respectably first time out in a 7f maiden at Galway, hard to be sure if 6f will suit

runners.name: Williamsburg
runners.spotlight: Ran green but showed some ability when 5l seventh of 12 on his debut at Leopardstown; improvement is feasible.
runners.comment: Ran green but showed some ability when 5l seventh of 12 on his debut at Leopardstown

runners.name: Cromane
runners.spotlight: Finished behind Heart Of You at Galway on the more recent of two outings; might need to qualify for a handicap mark.
runners.comment: Finished behind Heart Of You at Galway, might need to qualify for a handicap mark

runners.name: Roeillaun
runners.spotlight: Plenty of improvement is needed from her opening efforts at Naas and Cork.
runners.comment: Plenty of improvement is needed from her opening efforts at Naas and Cork

runners.name: Savannah Sun
runners.spotlight: Fifth foal; Arizona filly, closely related to three winners by No Nay Never; unraced dam out of US 1m winning half-sister to 6f/7f Group 1 winner Wolfhound and to smart dam of BC Classic winner A P Indy; cheekpieces on for debut
runners.comment: Arizona filly, closely related to three winners by No Nay Never, cheekpieces on for debut

runners.name: Kindacan
runners.spotlight: Ninth foal; Kodi Bear filly is a sister to 6f turf Listed/7f AW winner Clounmacon, half-sister to three other winners, including the versatile Nibiru; dam 6f winner, including at two; of some interest.
runners.comment: Sister to 6f Listed winner Clounmacon, half-sister to three winners, of some interest

runners.name: Lion Of Fortune
runners.spotlight: Invincible Army colt has a decent pedigree, from the immediate family of 6f Group 1 winner G Force and US 1m Grade 3 winner Louvain (dam of French 1,000 Guineas winner Flotilla); failed to sell cheaply as a yearling.
runners.comment: Invincible Army colt has a decent pedigree, failed to sell cheaply as a yearling

runners.name: Fighting Tears
runners.spotlight: Cheap yearling; half-sister by Lucky Vega to a 1m winner; dam a US-Stakes winner from a solid family; plenty of speed in trhe pedigree.
runners.comment: Cheap yearling, half-sister by Lucky Vega to a 1m winner, dam a US-Stakes winner

runners.name: Mickian Thomas
runners.spotlight: First foal; Alkumait colt, dam 5f winner by Ardan, half-sister to 6f 2yo winner Nifty; others are more likely.
runners.comment: First foal, Alkumait colt out of a 5f winner by Ardan, others are more likely

runners.name: Tavernise
runners.spotlight: Second foal. half-sister by Earthlight to an AW winner; dam a winning daughter of Iffraaj.
runners.comment: Second foal, half-sister by Earthlight to an AW winner, dam a winning daughter of Iffraaj

runners.name: Little Diva
runners.spotlight: Made late headway from an unpromising position at Bellewstown; well beaten at Leopardstown.
runners.comment: Made late headway from an unpromising position at Bellewstown, well beaten at Leopardstown

runners.name: Cat Blade
runners.spotlight: GBP58,000 Y; first foal; dam 7f winner, half-sister to several winners; speedy pedigree, could go well on debut.
runners.comment: GBP58,000 yearling; first foal; dam 7f winner, speedy pedigree, could go well on debut

runners.name: Killashee Supreme
runners.spotlight: E36,000 yearling, half-sister by Supremacy to Listed winner Popmaster, and two other winners; dam a 7f AW winner by Clodovil.
runners.comment: E36,000 yearling, half-sister by Supremacy to Listed winner Popmaster, dam 7f Aw winner

runners.name: The Long Haul
runners.spotlight: Tailed off when the rank outsider of five at Leopardstown last month; can be ruled out.
runners.comment: Tailed off when the rank outsider of five at Leopardstown last month, can be ruled out

runners.name: This That
runners.spotlight: First outing at Leopardstown was more encouraging than Wednesday's mid-division Gowran effort; more likely a handicap prospect.
runners.comment: First outing at Leopardstown was more encouraging than Wednesday's Gowran effort

runners.name: Run Johnny Run
runners.spotlight: Naas run represented an improvement from his debut at Navan, a lot more progress needed.
runners.comment: Naas run represented an improvement from his debut at Navan, a lot more progress needed

runners.name: Closed Loop
runners.spotlight: Has finished in front of only one of his 27 rivals in races at Naas and Sligo.
runners.comment: Has finished in front of only one of his 27 rivals in races at Naas and Sligo

races.race_name: Melbourne Cup Carnival Handicap

runners.name: Alto Sax
runners.spotlight: Winner this year over 1m at Dundalk and 1m2f at Fairyhouse in June; good form in defeat over 1m1f at Leopardstown, beaten a neck in a 22-runner contest; fair run over a longer trip last time, this may be closer to his best distance.
runners.comment: Has been running over longer distances in recent months, Dundalk winner over 1m in April

runners.name: Ella's Gold
runners.spotlight: Placed in all but one of her five handicap starts; capable of winning one with just a little improvement; the addition of cheekpieces could perhaps make the difference.
runners.comment: Placed in all but one of her five handicap starts; does not need to improve much to win

runners.name: Neo Smart
runners.spotlight: Two wins on AW, 1-30 turf record is a negative; respectable form lately; not a lost cause judged on her fourth in a 20-runner C&D event and same placing at Gowran nine days ago.
runners.comment: Two wins on AW, 1-30 turf record is a negative, respectable form lately, not a lost cause

runners.name: Comfort Line
runners.spotlight: A winner of seven races on AW and three on turf; last turf success was in 2022, but this season's overall form provided a fair amount of encouragement; a three-time runner-up at this venue, including in June; had plenty of horses behind him at Leopardstown ten days ago.
runners.comment: Holds a definite chance on recent turf form despite having a better record on AW

runners.name: Lamberella
runners.spotlight: Moderate form in her three handicap outings; hard to identify her optimum distance; others are more appealing.
runners.comment: Moderate form in her three handicap outings, hard to identify her optimum distance

runners.name: Tofino
runners.spotlight: Recorded her sole success in this race last season; also ran well when third in a 26-runner contest here late last season; uneven form this term; stable has hit a good patch of form this week; worth considering.
runners.comment: Winner of only one of her 19 starts, that was in this race last year, worth considering

runners.name: Kitty Bear
runners.spotlight: Three wins this year; unplaced in four outings since a Roscommon victory in May; needs to show signs of a return to form before being a betting proposition again.
runners.comment: Three wins this year, unplaced in four outings since a Roscommon victory in May
runners.owner: Charles Kerwin & Brendan Kerwin & Liam Kehoe

runners.name: Marambo
runners.spotlight: Fair AW form late last year; 40-1 and ran accordingly on handicap/turf/seasonal debut at Killarney last month.
runners.comment: Fair AW form late last year, 40-1 and ran accordingly on handicap/turf/seasonal debut

runners.name: Sancerre Rock
runners.spotlight: Ordinary form in maidens; outpaced over 7f at Gowran on handicap debut; two headgear items added now; not one of the more obvious contenders.
runners.comment: Ordinary form in maidens, outpaced over 7f on handicap debut, two headgear items added now

runners.name: Pallatine Hills
runners.spotlight: Placed only once from 13 starts, may have needed a recent run after a break; not the most consistent type.
runners.comment: Placed only once from 13 starts, may have needed a recent run after a break, inconsistent

runners.name: Avec Grand Plaisir
runners.spotlight: Ordinary form in maidens; stayed on for third over this trip at Cork in June on his handicap debut; failed to stay the extended 1m2f in a recent Sligo claimer.
runners.comment: Fair third over this trip at Cork in his first handicap, failed to stay in a Sligo claimer

runners.name: Bundle Of Interest
runners.spotlight: 6f winner last year; never involved on seasonal return at Naas in May; met trouble in running at Gowran nine days ago, when Neo Smart finished three places ahead of her; contender now.
runners.comment: 6f winner last year, met trouble in running at Gowran nine days ago. contender now

runners.name: Sherekiya
runners.spotlight: Ran respectably in three decent maidens over a mile last year; should be better for her handicap/seasonal debut over 7f at Naas; this extra furlong should suit.
runners.comment: Should be better for her handicap/seasonal debut at Naas, this extra furlong should suit
runners.owner: Exors Of The Late H H Aga Khan

runners.name: Navajo Point
runners.spotlight: Showed winning potential for the first time when fourth over this trip on AW last month; turf form has not been convincing; runs in 5.10 at Dundalk on Saturday.
runners.comment: Showed winning potential for the first time when fourth over this trip on AW last month

runners.name: Cannonball Queen
runners.spotlight: Failed to beat a single opponent in her first three races this term; attracted some support and produced a vastly improved effort at Leopardstown; possibly on the upgrade but 3lb wrong here; cheekpieces worn at Leopardstown are left off.
runners.comment: Dire form before a vastly improved effort at Leopardstown, possibly on the upgrade

runners.name: Dinamine
runners.spotlight: Took a long time to win a race; scored twice last season and added another win last month in first-time cheekpieces, overcoming a slow start to score over this trip at Naas; had a troubled passage and found 7f a bit sharp at Galway.
runners.comment: Seems best suited by this trip, had a troubled passage and found 7f a bit sharp at Galway.

races.race_name: Velo "Official Coffee At The Curragh" Irish EBF Maiden

runners.name: Zarak Pasha
runners.spotlight: A 75,000gns breeze-up purchase in April and from a middle-distance family; recovered from a slow start to run well over 1m on debut at Killarney; picked up useful experience behind an Aidan O'Brien-trained favourite at Galway and had 4l to spare over today's rival Thomas Chippendale; the selected of a stable quartet.
runners.comment: Ran green at Killarney, picked up useful experience at Galway, selected of stable quartet

runners.name: Angels Have Wings
runners.spotlight: Eighth foal; Camelot filly is a sister to middle-distance winner Sir Lamorak, half-sister to winners A New Dawn (Group-placed 6f 2yo) and Jewelry (6f 2yo); dam 5f 2yo winner, half-sister to 1m4f Group 1 winner Bracelet.
runners.comment: Camelot filly is a sister to a winner, half-sister to two winners, dam 5f juvenile winner
runners.owner: Mrs John Magnier & Michael Tabor & Derrick Smith

runners.name: Dancinginthecity
runners.spotlight: E140,000 yearling; fourth foal; half-brother by Saxon Warrior to three winners who stayed middle distances effectively; dam Listed-placed winner on the Flat and useful 2m hurdle winner, sister to German 1m3f Group 3 winner Pagera.
runners.comment: E140,000 yearling, fourth foal; half-brother to three winners, dam a Listed-placed winner

runners.name: Moon Sand
runners.spotlight: E105,000 yearling; second foal; dam French 1m AW 2yo/1m1f turf winner, half-sister to French winners Likala (1m2f Listed) and Liyann (useful 1m 2yo), out of 1m 2yo winning half-sister to Australian 1m Group 2 winner Lidari.
runners.comment: E105,000 yearling, second foal; Sea The Moon colt, dam French AW/turf winner

runners.name: Tommy Quick
runners.spotlight: Fifth foal; half-brother to US 1m turf winner For The Flag; dam runner-up 1m in France and US, sister to winners Civil Union (US 1m2f Grade 1) and War Dispatch (French 1m1f Group 3), out of unraced half-sister to HK 1m4f Group 1 winner Line Of Battle.
runners.comment: American Pharaoh colt is a half-brother to US turf winner, one of four for the stable

runners.name: Palazzo Serristori
runners.spotlight: Fourth foal; brother to US 8.5f turf winner Totally Justified, half-brother to two winners, including Masteroffoxhounds (US turf Grade 2; 115); dam 1m and 1m2f (Listed) winner, by Galileo, sister to BC Turf winner Magician.
runners.comment: Justify colt is a brother to a US Listed juvenile winner, well-related dam by Galileo
runners.owner: Mrs John Magnier & Michael Tabor & Derrick Smith

runners.name: Albany County
runners.spotlight: E420,000 F; eleventh foal; half-brother by Camelot to seven winners, including 1,000 Guineas winner Mother Earth and Pattern scorers Ocean Jewel and Night Colours; dam a Listed winner by Green Desert; one of three runners for the stable, good apprentice aboard.
runners.comment: E420,000 foal purchase, half-brother to 1,000 Guineas winner Mother Earth
runners.owner: Michael Tabor & Derrick Smith & Mrs John Magnier

runners.name: Grand Cru Classe
runners.spotlight: E65,000 Y; seventh foal; Sea The Stars colt is brother to five winners; dam AW winner, sister to 6f 2yo Group 2 winner Buratino.
runners.comment: E65,000 yearling; seventh foal, See The Stars colt is a brother to five winners

runners.name: Play Of Light
runners.spotlight: E42,000 yearling; tenth foal; half-brother by Dawn Approach to five winners including Group 2 scorer Turret Rocks (May Hill Stakes), and Beyond Thankful (Australian Group 3); dam placed 1m4f AW, out of well-related 1m2f winner.
runners.comment: E42,000 yearling, half-brother to five winners including Group 2 scorer Turret Rocks

runners.name: Thomas Chippendale
runners.spotlight: E300,000 yearling was the stable's second-string when third of four at Galway; finished 4l behind Zarak Pasha; may be capable of narrowing that gap with experience under his belt; from the Galileo/Sea The Stars family, so the extra distance can only help.
runners.comment: Finished 4l behind Zarak Pasha at Galway, may be capable of narrowing that gap

runners.name: Breath Of Paradise
runners.spotlight: E120,000 Breeze Up purchase; already looked in need of further when a remote fourth over 7f at this venue on debut; likely to be capable of improvement from the experience gained then.
runners.comment: Already looked in need of further when a remote fourth over 7f at this venue on debut

races.race_name: Tote Guarantee, Never Beaten By SP Handicap

runners.name: Blackjack Hills
runners.spotlight: AW winner at this trip last autumn and easily best of three turf runs this summer when beaten a neck over this trip at Leopardstown; may not have handled the track at Galway latest (softer ground) but definite chance on that Leopardstown run.
runners.comment: May not have handled the track at Galway, big chance on previous Leopardstown second

runners.name: Unterberg
runners.spotlight: Best on AW (six wins) but just 1-21 on turf; scored at Dundalk in March but soundly beaten back on turf of late; jockey booking encouraging off a reduced mark.
runners.comment: Recent form uninspiring but jockey booking encouraging off a reduced mark

runners.name: Mighty Danu
runners.spotlight: Won a 7f maiden (yielding) on debut at the Galway festival last season; only seen three times since, never sighted on last month's handicap debut at Leopardstown (7f); marked step up in trip here and could be a suspect stayer.
runners.comment: Marked step up in trip here and could be a suspect stayer

runners.name: Storzando
runners.spotlight: Lightly raced 3yo, easily pick of three maiden runs when rallying 1l third to Youcansaythatagain over this trip at Down Royal; well below that form at Galway since however over shorter; should appreciate return to 1m2f for handicap debut.
runners.comment: Down Royal third to Youcansaythatagain augurs well; nicely weighted on handicap bow

runners.name: Great Mover
runners.spotlight: Only win from 24 starts came on heavy ground at Gowran last September; couple of good placed efforts at Leopardstown this term but needs to improve on recent form.
runners.comment: Couple of good placings at Leopardstown this term but needs to improve on recent form

runners.name: Thyer
runners.spotlight: Dual 1m winner in Britain, both on good ground; steady return to form of late, most recently in first-time visor at Galway, racing keenly when good third of 16 over 1m4f (yielding); step back in trip could suit now.
runners.comment: Galway run a step in the right direction; step back in trip could suit

runners.name: Nibras Rainbow
runners.spotlight: Has been in good form this summer with wins at both Killarney and Leopardstown over slightly shorter; decent run at Ballinrobe afterwards, but Gowran effort on Wednesday was disappointing; 3lb out of handicap here.
runners.comment: Generally good form until Ballinrobe blip on Tuesday; 3lb wrong here

runners.name: Admiral Will Brown
runners.spotlight: Nicely improved on yard debut to win over this trip at Navan last month, didn't appear to stay 1m4f at Galway 16 days later; could still have more to offer at this trip.
runners.comment: Navan winner at this trip didn't appear to stay 1m4f at Galway; back in trip now

runners.name: Guinelot
runners.spotlight: Nicely improved on third maiden outing this summer to land Ballinrobe contest over just shy of this trip, just outbattling a subsequent winner (pair clear); opening mark looks handy, could go well.
runners.comment: Ballinrobe maiden win franked since; opening mark looks handy, could go well

runners.name: Youcansaythatagain
runners.spotlight: Lightly raced Ghaiyyath colt; promising debut in C&D maiden on Derby weekend and following month justified favouritism in similar Down Royal contest, still green but asserting late on to win a shade snugly; likely has more to offer and interesting stepping into handicap company.
runners.comment: Down Royal maiden winner likely has more to offer and interesting stepping into a handicap

runners.name: Liberation Date
runners.spotlight: Sole win came in an AW 7f maiden at Dundalk in December; had the run of the race under today's rider in a premier handicap here (1m1f, good) when a career-best third but unable to back that up over shorter at Galway; tries this trip for the first time.
runners.comment: Penultimate Curragh run promising but more needed upped in trip

runners.name: Sonoran
runners.spotlight: Yet to add to tally since maiden win at Tipperary last year; good third at Leopardstown in May (1m2f, good) but hasn't built on that and handicapper slow to relent.
runners.comment: Good third at Leopardstown in May (1m2f, good) but hasn't built on that

races.race_name: Newbridge Silverware Royal Whip Stakes (Group 3)

runners.name: A Boy Named Susie
runners.spotlight: Holds outstanding claims here despite having only a debut win to his name; form last season and this term ties in with several top-class Ballydoyle colts, including when fourth behind three of them in the Prix du Jockey-Club and when splitting Constitution River and Hawk Mountain in the Eclipse.
runners.comment: Holds outstanding claims, boasts Group 1 form linked to several of Ballydoyle's stars

runners.name: Omni Man
runners.spotlight: Handicap winner over 1m4f at Goodwood last season; low-key efforts in April/May before showing signs of a return to form when fifth in a 1m4f Royal Ascot handicap; faded into fourth behind Ethical Diamond in a 1m4f Group 3 event at Leopardstown ten days ago.
runners.comment: Looks like the one most likely to test A Boy Named Susie but faces a tough task

runners.name: Cowardofthecounty
runners.spotlight: Group 3 winner over 7f at Deauville as a 2yo; lost way last season, back to form this term; won a conditions race at Fairyhouse (7f, good); stronger form in defeat, notably when second in a 1m1f Group 3 event at Leopardstown; failed to uphold form with Isaac Newton over 1m at the same venue ten days ago.
runners.comment: Has run several good races in defeat this year, slightly inferior to stablemate Omni Man

runners.name: Rebel Ascendant
runners.spotlight: Debut maiden winner on soft at Gowran in April, saw out the extended 1m1f well despite running green; moderate fourth of five at Roscommon the following month; cheekpieces fitted now; up against it.
runners.comment: Debut winner at Gowran in April, moderate fourth of five at Roscommon the following month

runners.name: Charles Fort
runners.spotlight: Useful form in juvenile maidens, culminating in a 6f Cork win on yielding-to-soft last September; found to be lame when an unplaced favourite for a 6f Listed race at Fairyhouse later that month; makes a belated return; may outrun his 89 rating but faces a huge task
runners.comment: Lame on final start at two, faces an unenviable task but may outrun his 89 rating
runners.owner: Westerberg & Mrs Magnier & M Tabor & D Smith

races.race_name: William Hill Irish EBF Juvenile Sprint Stakes (Listed Race)

runners.name: Armor Supreme
runners.spotlight: All three runs have been in Britain, winning Goodwood novice in May, beaten a head in York Listed a fortnight later and creditable ninth of 27 behind Victorious in Group 2 Queen Mary at Ascot on good-to-firm; has had a break since and heads a strong stable challenge here.
runners.comment: Smart form in Britain; back from a break and heads a strong stable challenge
runners.owner: Team Valor International, D Dias,M Eves

runners.name: Brazilian Diva
runners.spotlight: Plenty of experience, winning Naas maiden (beating April Mist 2.5l) and much better form when narrowly defeated in Listed at same venue last month; keen when beaten 5l in Group 3 Molecomb Stakes on latest; definite claims.
runners.comment: Keen when beaten 5l in Group 3 Molecomb; definite claims on previous Naas form

runners.name: Concorde Landed
runners.spotlight: Sioux Nation filly made favourable first impression with a 5l Naas maiden win last month but ran below expectations (favourite) in Fillies' Listed over same C&D 18 days later, keen to post and not quite getting home when fourth to a stablemate; tried hooded now and remains capable of better.
runners.comment: Didn't do herself justice in Naas Listed; hooded now and remains capable of better

runners.name: Grayrobin
runners.spotlight: Well beaten on debut when trained by Archie Watson but 2-2 since joining this yard, showing plenty of speed when up with the pace in winning Bellewstown maiden and Cork rated event (much better form) on good-to-firm; should make another bold bid although stiffer 5f here.
runners.comment: Speedy type unbeaten in two for yard; should make another bold bid although stiffer 5f

runners.name: April Mist
runners.spotlight: Promising Naas debut in June was quickly followed by a Bellewstown maiden win at this trip (good); unable to handle step up to Listed company on latest and needs to find more.
runners.comment: Bellewstown maiden win not working out; needs to find more

runners.name: Star Prospect
runners.spotlight: C&D debut winner in April (soft) is 0-4 since, notably Cork rated third to Grayrobin (rec 5lb); never able to land a blow in valuable Ballyhane Stakes on first run over 6f latest; place claims.
runners.comment: C&D maiden winner needs a bit more to reverse Cork form with Grayrobin

runners.name: New Bond Street
runners.spotlight: Second runner for the owners/trainer; 0-3 in 6f maidens, including Naas third to a subsequent Group 2 winner, and didn't quite get home here a week ago; back in trip now and don't rule out.
runners.comment: 0-3 in 6f maidens but don't rule out back in trip

runners.name: The Baddie
runners.spotlight: Space Traveller half-sister to Polish 6f 2yo winner Serce; dam Listed-placed 5f winner (RPR 92), half-sister to winners Brooklands Bay (8.6f 2yo) and Majestic Timeline (5f); likely outsider of the yard's trio of runners, all the better for the experience.
runners.comment: Likely outsider of the yard's trio of runners, all the better for the experience

runners.name: Arrowstock
runners.spotlight: Maiden whose standout run came when fifth of 10 in Naas Listed last month, fourth in Cork maiden on Friday.
runners.comment: Maiden whose standout run came when fifth of 10 in Naas Listed; 4th in Cork maiden Friday

runners.name: Stellar Path
runners.spotlight: Yet to trouble the judge in four runs; looks out of her depth here.
runners.comment: Yet to trouble the judge in four runs; looks out of her depth here

races.race_name: Bet With Tote On Racing & Sports Handicap

runners.name: Soulful Diva
runners.spotlight: Won 5f Cork maiden a year ago (good) and didn't reappear until last month, encouraging comeback run at Fairyhouse (6f) but didn't get home at Naas three weeks later over same trip; return to 5f should suit and handicapper has dropped her 4lb.
runners.comment: Return to 5f should suit and handicapper has dropped her 4lb

runners.name: Bold Optimist
runners.spotlight: Two-time turf winner in 2024, including over C&D; good AW run last winter and fine return from over three months' absence when second at Naas last month off reduced mark (third has won since); definite player.
runners.comment: Naas comeback second puts him right in the mix

runners.name: Arctic Steps
runners.spotlight: Was gaining second turf win when scoring over this trip at Naas in May off 68; safely held both starts since, latest over same C&D so needs to improve; jockey booking encouraging.
runners.comment: Naas winner safely held since so good bit more needed

runners.name: Mary Shoelaces
runners.spotlight: Three of her four wins have come over C&D, including for second successive year last month when making much of running in beating Harry's Hill 0.5l on good-to-firm (Happy Henry fifth) under today's rider; 6lb rise but has to be respected given her record here.
runners.comment: C&D specialist; up 6lb for last month's defeat of Harry's Hill; has to be respected

runners.name: Harry's Hill
runners.spotlight: Nine-time winner, including twice over C&D; no joy yet this season, going closest on latest when staying on well into second late on behind 0.5l winner Mary Shoelaces over C&D last month on ground on the quick side for him; nice turn around in the weights with that rival, with rider now claiming.
runners.comment: Recent C&D second to Mary Shoelaces augurs well; weighted to reverse that form

runners.name: Ballysax Lil' Mick
runners.spotlight: Got off the mark at Tipperary a year ago over this trip; hasn't added to that, short of room when last seen at Naas in late June; handicapper giving him every chance (1lb wrong).
runners.comment: Short of room when last seen at Naas in late June; handicapper giving him every chance

runners.name: Surpass And Shine
runners.spotlight: Dual winner over this trip last season at Naas and Down Royal; gelded on the back of a couple of poor runs and return to 7f backfired at Fairyhouse on latest; questions to answer at this stage although handicapper quick to relent and 1lb below last winning mark now.
runners.comment: Recent form uninspiring but now 1lb below last winning mark

runners.name: Happy Henry
runners.spotlight: In good form this summer over this trip on quick ground, winning at Navan and Bellewstown; not a bad effort after aggregate 17lb rise when under 2l off Mary Shoelaces over C&D last month, staying on after briefly short of room; respected.
runners.comment: Progressive sprinter; under 2l off Mary Shoelaces over C&D latest when short of room

runners.name: Lady Landhort
runners.spotlight: Sole success came in 6f Dundalk handicap in March off 49; has changed yards since fair turf effort at Down Royal in late May; 3lb wrong here; last of 12 at Cork on Friday on first start for this stable.
runners.comment: Fair effort at Down Royal in May; last of 12 at Cork on Friday on stable debut, 3lb wrong
runners.owner: T J Flanagan & Ronan Macken & Shane McSweeney & S O'Malley

runners.name: Heart Of Eternity
runners.spotlight: Godolphin cast-off; rated 74 after making the frame on all three starts for Charlie Appleby; now down to 56 after being tried over various trips this term; cheekpieces tried.
runners.comment: Regressive 4yo has plummeted in ratings; yet to convince at this trip

runners.name: Kiss Don't Tell
runners.spotlight: Lightly raced maiden showed some measure of ability on final two maiden runs last year; shaped like the run was needed when beaten 6l at Cork on Friday.
runners.comment: Lightly-raced 3yo shaped like the run was needed when beaten 6l at Cork on Friday

runners.name: Pure Valour
runners.spotlight: Lightly raced 4yo finished stone last on last month's handicap debut over 1m; speedily-bred so could improve for this marked drop in trip; 2lb wrong
runners.comment: Lightly raced 4yo is speedily-bred so could improve for this marked drop in trip
runners.owner: Mrs Annette Coogan & J M O'Reilly & Frank Condra

races.race_name: Enter ITV7 For Free EBF Novice Stakes (GBB Race)

runners.name: Diamondsforyou
runners.spotlight: Second foal; St Mark's Basilica half-sister to connections 5f/6f 2yo winner Catching The Moon (including Group 3); dam 1m4f winner (RPR 72), half-sister to Group-placed 5f 2yo winner Pearls And Rubies, out of 1m2f Group 1 winner; takes on males on debut but no surprise to see a good run.
runners.comment: Half-sister to connections 6f 2yo Group 3 winner Catching The Moon; could go well on debut

runners.name: Varzi
runners.spotlight: 170,000euros yearling who was second on debut at York in May (5f, good; 2-1 favourite) and, while he was no match for the winner, that was Cut A Dash who was subsequently fourth at Royal Ascot; the tongue-tie is retained for this first run since; entered in the Group 2 Mill Reef; sets a useful standard.
runners.comment: 2nd at York in May; this is his first run since; sets useful standard for rest to aim at

runners.name: Magic Harry
runners.spotlight: 40,000euros yearling, 85,000euros 2yo breeze-ups; fifth foal; Harry Angel half-brother to French winners Victoire Magique (1m2f/1m7f including 2yo/Listed) and Enchantment (1m1f AW); dam 1m-1m6f winner (including 2yo; RPR 98); makes debut with trainer's 2yos in good form; in calculations.
runners.comment: 85,000euros breeze-up buy; makes debut with trainer's 2yos in good form; in calculations

runners.name: North Coates
runners.spotlight: Second foal; dam 7f/1m winner (RPR 78), half-sister to winners Bocking End (1m-1m2f) and Archie Stevens (5f/6f including 2yo); a market check is advised but this Belardo newcomer is likely to improve for the outing.
runners.comment: Dam 7f/1m winner (RPR 78); check market on debut but he's likely to improve for the run

runners.name: Princeland
runners.spotlight: 320,000gns yearling; third foal; Havana Grey half-brother to 6f 2yo Group 3 winner Tadej; dam placed 1m/1m2f (RPR 75), from classy family; powerful Newmarket stable is having an excellent season with 2yos; major player.
runners.comment: 320,000gns yearling; half-brother to 6f 2yo Group 3 winner Tadej; major player on debut

races.race_name: Sky Bet For The Fans Fillies' Handicap

runners.name: Darzah
runners.spotlight: Beat Luna Celeste to win at Newmarket (1m, good to firm) in June on her second handicap start; disappointing behind that rival at Nottingham (1m, good to firm) subsequently but she retains potential for her top yard; could be on a good mark if bouncing back to form.
runners.comment: Won at Newmarket on second handicap start; disappointing since but retains potential

runners.name: Two B Tanned
runners.spotlight: Front-runner who posted five wins last year and reappeared with another at Musselburgh (1m, good) in April; unplaced on both starts since and, while she didn't run badly back at Musselburgh last time, she's taking on 3yos this afternoon and may again prove vulnerable.
runners.comment: Unplaced on last two starts; takes on 3yos this afternoon and may again prove vulnerable

runners.name: Luna Celeste
runners.spotlight: Won Leicester maiden (6f, good to firm) in May on third start and progressive in handicaps since, going close behind Darzah at Newmarket (1m, good to firm) then making all at Nottingham (1m, good to firm); came clear with the runner-up last time and she's very much respected up 6lb.
runners.comment: Came clear with the runner-up to win at Nottingham on second handicap start; respected

runners.name: Si Grass
runners.spotlight: 1m AW novice winner who was beaten just over 3l when eighth of 14 on last month's handicap debut at Glorious Goodwood (1m, good); that came after a break and she may be able to build on that performance today; a possible.
runners.comment: Respectable in midfield on handicap debut at Glorious Goodwood, after a break; a possible

runners.name: Quisana
runners.spotlight: She's run to a similar level on all five starts and made all in a five-runner maiden at Nottingham (1m, good to firm) a fortnight ago; improvement is needed if she's to follow up on this handicap debut but she's unexposed in the hood (worn on last two starts) and is not ruled out.
runners.comment: Consistent sort who won Nottingham maiden on fifth start; not ruled out on handicap debut

races.race_name: EBF Sky Bet Club Flying Fillies' Stakes (Listed Race) (Fillies & Mares)

runners.name: Royal Fixation
runners.spotlight: Won the Group 2 Lowther Stakes at York (6f, good to firm) last August and she took a step back in the right direction when 3l fifth of 13 there last month in the Group 3 Summer Stakes (6f, good to firm; America Queen fourth), when slowly away in first-time tongue-tie/cheekpieces (both retained); she's capable of building on that latest effort and is one to consider.
runners.comment: Last year's Lowther winner; step back in right direction at York latest; one to consider

runners.name: America Queen
runners.spotlight: 0-5, all in Group races, since winning on debut last July but she's produced some big performances in the interim, most recently a close fourth in the Group 3 Summer Stakes at York (6f, good to firm); that latest form has worked out well and this front-runner can make a bold bid from stall two.
runners.comment: Fourth in Group 3 at York last time and that form has worked out well; can make a bold bid

runners.name: Magic Basma
runners.spotlight: 0-13 since winning on her debut in August 2024 but she was second in this last year (good to firm) and has been running well in defeat in Listed races this season; there's every chance that she'll be thereabouts.
runners.comment: Losing run continues but second in this last year and running well this term; thereabouts

runners.name: Ruby's Angel
runners.spotlight: Won handicap at Chester (6f, good) in May and ran well when fifth of 20 in competitive fillies' handicap at Glorious Goodwood (6f, good) last time; however, she has plenty to find against the pick of today's opposition.
runners.comment: Some good handicap form this season but plenty to find against the pick of today's rivals

runners.name: Miss Nightcap
runners.spotlight: 3yo who made her debut only in May; made all at Wolverhampton (7f, AW) in June on her third start then did likewise on handicap debut at Leicester (6f, good to firm); others have more substance to their form but she was impressive last time and it remains to be seen where her limitations lie.
runners.comment: Easily made all on h'cap debut at Leicester; remains to be seen where her limitations lie
runners.owner: E S-O Racing Club And Elaine Chivers

runners.name: Arabian Dusk
runners.spotlight: This is her first run since last July but she returns with her stable in fine form and she went very close in the Group 2 Sandy Lane Stakes at Haydock (6f, good) last May; in the mix if at the top of her game; wears a first-time tongue-tie.
runners.comment: Returns from absence but with stable in fine form; in the mix if at the top of her game

runners.name: Dash Of Azure
runners.spotlight: Down the field in Group 3 Oak Tree Stakes at Goodwood (7f, good to firm) last time but prior to that she went close in two Listed races at Chester (7f, good); has a part to play if leaving last time behind.
runners.comment: Down the field in Group 3 latest but went close in two Listed races at Chester previously

runners.name: Catching The Moon
runners.spotlight: Made it 2-3 in 2yo campaign with Group 3 win at Ayr last September; she's had excuses on both runs this season (interference; upset in stalls) but has been well beaten each time and others arrive with less to prove.
runners.comment: 2yo Group 3 winner last September but well beaten on both starts this season

runners.name: Sing The Blues
runners.spotlight: Lightly raced 3yo who was sold out of William Haggas's yard for 6,000gns on July 1 and has proved to be a bargain buy for new connections, making it 2-2 for current yard when winning big-field fillies' handicap at Glorious Goodwood (6f, good); today's assignment demands further improvement but she's clearly thriving and is not ruled out.
runners.comment: 2-2 for new yard; this assignment demands further improvement but she's clearly thriving

runners.name: Brazilian Rose
runners.spotlight: Raced wide when well beaten at 150-1 in Group 3 Oak Tree Stakes at Goodwood (7f, good to firm) recently; unplaced in three Listed races prior to that; hard to fancy.
runners.comment: Hard to fancy judged on this summer's exploits in Listed and Group 3 races

runners.name: Killavia
runners.spotlight: Exploited a reduced mark to win Class 4 handicap at Ascot (5f, good to firm) last month; this 3yo may have more to offer now that things have clicked again but she looks up against it in today's line-up.
runners.comment: Won Class 4 handicap at Ascot last month; looks up against it in today's line-up

races.race_name: Sky Bet Price Boosts Handicap (GBBPlus Race)

runners.name: High Degree
runners.spotlight: 0-7 in handicaps and expensive to follow but he's run some big races this season, most recently second of six at Newmarket (1m2f, good to firm) behind a well-handicapped winner; wears first-time cheekpieces and can be bang there off the same mark as last time.
runners.comment: Proving expensive to follow in handicaps but good second last time and can be bang there

runners.name: Mr Seagull
runners.spotlight: Yet to pose a serious threat this season and unproven at the trip, but he kept on well for fifth in a hot race at Ascot (1m, good to firm) two starts ago, and he didn't run badly in a big-field 3yo handicap at Glorious Goodwood (1m, good to firm) last time; not ruled out in first-time visor.
runners.comment: Yet to pose a serious threat this season but not devoid of promise; not ruled out
runners.owner: Two Plus Three Two Plus Four

runners.name: Financer
runners.spotlight: Won four-runner handicap at Redcar (1m2f, good to firm) last month and close fourth of 15 at York (1m, good to firm) next time; caught wide early and failed to settle when mid-division in competitive handicap at Haydock (1m, good) last Saturday so that run can be forgiven; not discounted.
runners.comment: Won at Redcar last month and latest run at Haydock can be forgiven; not discounted
runners.owner: S Bulmer, P Hebdon & R Taylor

runners.name: Ammes
runners.spotlight: Runner-up off 1lb higher at Redcar (1m2f, good to firm) in April and he's run respectably on his three starts since; this is less competitive than those last three outings and he might not be far away.
runners.comment: Running pretty well in the main since April and he might not be far away

runners.name: Without Compromise
runners.spotlight: Three 1m2f wins on Newcastle AW towards the end of last year and he returned from a break and wind surgery to finish second over C&D (good to firm) three weeks ago; he was no match for the winner Jez Bomb but is 7lb better off today and is not ruled out.
runners.comment: No match for winner Jez Bomb over C&D 3 weeks ago but was returning from four-month break

runners.name: Farasi Lane
runners.spotlight: 8yo who won off this mark on his stable debut at Ripon (1m, good) last month; two reasonable performances have followed (1m/1m2f, good to firm/good) but he needs something extra to come out on top today.
runners.comment: Won on stable debut last month; two reasonable runs since but needs something extra today

runners.name: Shoof Baeed
runners.spotlight: Made all at 15-2 on debut at Redcar (1m2f, good) in June and faded into sixth of eight in warm novice at Doncaster (1m4f, good to firm) last month, having failed to settle; this very lightly raced 3yo could be suited by the return to 1m2f on his handicap debut and he's a possible player.
runners.comment: 1m2f debut win then faded over 1m4f; return to 1m2f could suit on handicap debut

runners.name: Jez Bomb
runners.spotlight: Won here (1m, good) in June on first course visit; no match for the winner when second here (1m, good to firm) next time but he returned to winning ways in commanding fashion over today's C&D (good to firm) three weeks ago; a 7lb rise takes him to a career-high mark but he has to be respected.
runners.comment: Commanding win over C&D three weeks ago; has to be respected despite career-high mark

races.race_name: Sky Bet Build A Bet Handicap

runners.name: Fluorescence
runners.spotlight: Found a Group 3 too much at York last month but she was a very close third when back in a handicap at Hamilton (5f, good) a fortnight ago; she was denied a clear run last time and this progressive 4yo could be firmly in the mix up 2lb.
runners.comment: Very close third at Hamilton when denied a clear run and she could be firmly in the mix

runners.name: Reigning Profit
runners.spotlight: Soundly beaten over C&D (good to firm) two runs ago but prior to that he won at Ripon (5f, good), and he posted a respectable effort at Glorious Goodwood (5f, good) last time; he's won here four times; not ruled out.
runners.comment: Respectable effort at Glorious Goodwood and this four-time course winner is not ruled out

runners.name: One And Gone
runners.spotlight: 3yo who made all in eight-runner handicap at Goodwood (5f, good) in June and rallied to follow up at Sandown (5f, good), beating four rivals; down the field at Glorious Goodwood last time but he's back into a smaller field today and could give it a good go from the front.
runners.comment: Won 2 in a row then down the field at Glorious Goodwood, but back into smaller field here

runners.name: Kylian
runners.spotlight: His mark continues to fall and there were promising signs at Newcastle (5f, AW) in June; however, two lesser runs have followed and he has to turn things around in a first-time visor (has worn cheekpieces/blinkers this term).
runners.comment: His mark continues to fall but he has to turn things around in a first-time visor
runners.owner: Middleham Park Racing Xii & Mrs G Cowell

runners.name: Baker Blue
runners.spotlight: Front-runner who was overhauled by Badri when runner-up over C&D (good to firm) last month and he again ran well when sixth of 18 at Glorious Goodwood (5f, good to firm); this is less competitive; he can make a bold bid.
runners.comment: Runner-up over C&D then sixth of 18 at Glorious Goodwood; can make another bold bid

runners.name: Vintage Clarets
runners.spotlight: Twice went close in June (5f, good to soft) and he ran well once more when close seventh of 23 at Glorious Goodwood (5f, good) last time; could be in the shake-up.
runners.comment: Twice went close in June and ran well once more at Glorious Goodwood; could be in shake-up

runners.name: Badri
runners.spotlight: He couldn't get into it in a big field at Windsor (6f, good to firm) last Monday but he didn't enjoy an ideal passage and went there on a four-timer following three wins here (6f/5f, good/good to firm); this 9yo could play a leading role back at Pontefract.
runners.comment: Won three in a row here then couldn't get into it at Pontefract; could play leading role

runners.name: Rocking Ends
runners.spotlight: With this visor back on he won at Newmarket (5f, good to firm) last month, landing that handicap for the third year in succession; not beaten far when fifth of 13 at Ascot (5f, good to firm) since but he's never won off a mark this high and there's a suspicion he'll again be vulnerable.
runners.comment: Won at Newmarket before respectable fifth at Ascot; has never won off a mark this high

races.race_name: Sky Bet Extra Places Handicap (GBBPlus Race)

runners.name: Treasure Islands
runners.spotlight: Won at Ripon (2m, good) in April and Catterick (2m, good to firm) in June but he's not been as good at Newcastle or York (twice) since; back to his last winning mark.
runners.comment: 2m wins in April and June but not so good in his three starts since

runners.name: Pole Star
runners.spotlight: Two disappointing runs before a much more competitive show, still below form, when fifth of ten off this reduced mark in 2m Shergar Cup race at Ascot eight days ago; still needs to perk up somewhat but this is a drop back in class.
runners.comment: Latest run was better than previous two but he still needs to perk up; drop back in class
runners.owner: Sheikh Hamdan bin Mohammed Al Maktoum

runners.name: Campeona
runners.spotlight: Much improved since hiked up in trip and switched to handicaps, winning small-field events on fast ground when long odds-on at Bath (1m6f), Newbury (2m) and Lingfield (2m) on last three outings; raised another 2lb; can hang and carry head awkwardly but she keeps finding more when it matters and today's even greater test of stamina should suit her well.
runners.comment: On four-timer; can hang and carry head awkwardly but keeps finding more when it matters

runners.name: Letsbefrank
runners.spotlight: Ridden this season by Lauren Young; won at Musselburgh (1m4f) and Hamilton (1m3f) on first two starts, with a good third at Thirsk (1m4f) next time, all on good ground; shaped as if still in form in a steadily run race on latest outing; this good season (better than 2025) has been over much shorter but he did win this race on good to firm in 2024; not dismissed.
runners.comment: This good season (better than 2025) has been over much shorter but he did win this in 2024

runners.name: Sixty Plus
runners.spotlight: Reeled off four straight hurdle wins last summer before losing his way; switched to the Flat this summer and he's now 3-3 in Flat handicaps, having won on good to firm at Thirsk (1m4f), Lingfield (1m6f) and Nottingham (1m6f) in the space of a week last month; the last of those wins was much more hard fought, by a neck, and he's another 3lb higher today but 2m+ is plausible and he might yet do better still.
runners.comment: Unbeaten in Flat handicaps, having won three (1m4f/1m6f) in the space of a week last month

runners.name: Laafy
runners.spotlight: 10yo, very lightly raced in recent years with no significant impact; at least this race is a lot less competitive than the Northumberland Vase at Newcastle (2m, AW) last time in which he was beaten just over 6l into tenth of 20 and he's been dropped another 3lb.
runners.comment: Lightly raced recent years with no significant impact; tenth of 20 in Northumberland Vase

races.race_name: Sky Bet Proud To Support Young Lives Vs Cancer Handicap

runners.name: Alfa Whiteburd
runners.spotlight: Easily capitalised on a reduced mark at Chester (7f, good) last month and he's made all over this C&D on both starts since (good to firm); this 5yo is up to a career-high mark but has never been better and could prove tough to catch once more.
runners.comment: He's made all on his last three starts, over C&D on last two occasions; strong claims

runners.name: Yes I'm Mali
runners.spotlight: Twice went close last month at Newmarket (6f, good to firm) then ran pretty well when seventh of 21 at York (6f, good to firm) most recently; this is less competitive than last time and he could be thereabouts.
runners.comment: Went close twice in a row then respectable 7th of 21 at York; could be thereabouts

runners.name: Veblen Good
runners.spotlight: Won on stable/seasonal debut over C&D (good) in April and he ran really well in defeat last month, beaten only 1l when fourth of 21 at York (6f, good to firm) three weeks ago; solid contender.
runners.comment: Won over C&D in April and ran really well in defeat last month; solid contender

runners.name: Mondammej
runners.spotlight: 9yo who has dropped down the weights and showed spark when second of four at Nottingham last month; however, well beaten at Thirsk since and he's winless on turf since September 2021; others appeal more.
runners.comment: 9yo who showed spark two starts ago but well beaten at Thirsk since; others preferred

runners.name: Fiscal Policy
runners.spotlight: Below best on his last three starts but his recent Newmarket sixth was a step back in the right direction; made it 2-2 here when winning over C&D (good) in June and well worth a second look now back here.
runners.comment: Step back in right direction at Newmarket last time and he's 2-2 here; worth a second look
runners.owner: S Thompson, Mrs R Carr & G Shields

runners.name: Russet Gold
runners.spotlight: Encouraging start for this yard with two fifth-place finishes off higher marks in the spring; however, his form has gone the wrong way subsequently and he needs to turn things around.
runners.comment: Encouraging start for this yard in the spring but form has gone the wrong way subsequently

runners.name: The Good Biscuit
runners.spotlight: Won at Catterick (6f, good to firm) last month and beat three rivals to follow up over this C&D (good to firm); not written off after just one lesser run but he was only sixth of eight behind Alfa Whiteburd over C&D (good to firm) 11 days ago and has to bounce back.
runners.comment: Completed double with C&D win last month but only sixth of eight over C&D last time

runners.name: Havana Rum
runners.spotlight: A touch below par at York (6f, good to firm) three weeks ago but third of 19 there (6f, good to firm) two starts ago and he has an eyecatching record at Pontefract, having made the frame on each of his last five visits; firmly in calculations.
runners.comment: He has an eyecatching record at Pontefract and is firmly in calculations back here

runners.name: Rare Change
runners.spotlight: Inconsistent but he won at Goodwood (7f, soft) in June and wasn't beaten far when seventh of 17 at York (7f, good to firm) last time; his career-best performance came when winning easily over C&D (good) last June and he's an intriguing candidate back here; capable of playing a leading role.
runners.comment: Inconsistent but won two starts ago and his career-best form came over C&D last June
runners.owner: Mrs J Woods And K Lawrence

races.race_name: Newark Advertiser Handicap (GBBPus Race)

runners.name: Wonder
runners.spotlight: 3-15 on AW (last two wins were at this track) compared to 0-4 on turf; in good form at 1m4f on AW initially this year, including a second under Taryn Langley; there was a dip in April when last seen but it's easy to see him returning in a major role for his in-form yard.
runners.comment: In good form at 1m4f on AW initially this year; off since April but one to consider

runners.name: Jindri
runners.spotlight: Won off this mark over C&D last November; that's her only win from nine races and she was well beaten when 28-1 under 7lb claimer at Newcastle (Tapeta) last time, but her stable is in good form.
runners.comment: Won off this mark over C&D last November; well beaten latest start but yard in good form

runners.name: Domination
runners.spotlight: 2-4 for this yard with narrow wins at Ripon (1m) and Doncaster (1m2f); another creditable effort over 1m2f last time; needs to resume improvement, which may be possible as he's just a 3yo but he's not bred for this new trip; it's also his AW debut.
runners.comment: 2-4 for this yard and stays 1m2f; not bred for this new trip and it's also his AW debut

runners.name: Astrological
runners.spotlight: Won a 9.4f maiden at Wolverhampton (Tapeta) in April and over 11.4f on turf at Windsor in June in his second handicap; that's two wins from four starts and that latest performance was encouraging for this second crack at 1m4f; 3yo to consider seriously.
runners.comment: 2-4 and latest win was encouraging for a second crack at 1m4f; 3yo to consider seriously

runners.name: Cliff Danger
runners.spotlight: Best novice effort when fourth over 1m2f at Nottingham on second start, making most; never-dangerous ninth of 14 when 16-1 for handicap debut here six weeks ago but that was over just 1m, whereas his dam was a useful bumper and 1m6f Flat winner; stepped up markedly to 1m4f, he could now be a great deal more interesting.
runners.comment: Stepped up markedly to 1m4f, he could be a lot more interesting in this second handicap

runners.name: Bondi
runners.spotlight: Won two handicaps over about 1m4f last summer, in a mixed record; one of the lesser efforts was his AW debut (Kempton Polytrack) when last seen; left Richard Hannon for 20,000gns last October and this is his first run since (gelded in interim).
runners.comment: Won twice over about 1m4f last summer; mixed record; 20,000gns buy last October; off since

runners.name: Gallant Lion
runners.spotlight: Back to some form over 1m4f on turf on last two starts; 0-11 on AW, however, with two places but they were on Polytrack.
runners.comment: Back to some form over 1m4f on turf on last two starts; 0-11 on AW, however

runners.name: Typical Woman
runners.spotlight: Has the same mark as when winning at Lingfield (1m1f, good to firm) almost exactly one year ago, on her final start last season and the last time she was ridden by Billy Loughnane; that was her fifth career win, and she stays 1m4f and used to look effective on Tapeta but a revival is needed on this first run since May.
runners.comment: Same mark as for her turf win one year ago; stays 1m4f but needs a revival

runners.name: Naples
runners.spotlight: Dam 1m3f winner; 1m, heavy-ground maiden winner last September for Paddy Twomey; after his four 1m/1m2f handicaps for current yard this term, trying cheekpieces last time, others bring much more persuasive claims.
runners.comment: After four 1m/1m2f handicaps for current yard, others bring much more persuasive claims

runners.name: Yaa Min
runners.spotlight: Two wins this year over 1m4f on Lingfield Polytrack, dictating the pace on second occasion; good third at Kempton (also 1m4f on Polytrack) on latest start, which gives him each-way claims if it's transferred to Tapeta.
runners.comment: Two wins in 2026 over 1m4f on Polytrack; each-way claims if form is transferred to Tapeta

runners.name: Mehmas Champion
runners.spotlight: Fourth in the German 2,000 Guineas (1m, good) in May 2025 on his third start; however, absent for a year afterwards and he's been way below that form in his three starts for new yard this year, tenth of 11 on handicap debut last time; goes beyond 1m for the first time and, although he's by a speed influence, his dam was a good 1m-12.5f winner.
runners.comment: Out of form this year; goes beyond 1m first time and his dam was a good 1m-12.5f winner

runners.name: Motazzen
runners.spotlight: 50-1 winner of this race last year off 4lb lower; following 228 days off; 10l winner over hurdles this March, followed by two modest shows in May; had wind operation (his second) in July and needs a second look.
runners.comment: 50-1 winner of this last year off 4lb lower; wind surgery in July and needs a second look

races.race_name: Fraser Plus Designer Outlet East Midlands Handicap

runners.name: Ribston Pippin
runners.spotlight: No claims from last two starts but he was a C&D winner last December and second over C&D this April, which give him a chance.
runners.comment: No claims from last two starts but C&D winner last December and second over C&D this April

runners.name: Timebar
runners.spotlight: 0-18 but second in three of his last four starts; made most on last two occasions, the latest over 7f on Newcastle Tapeta; there's a bit more for him to prove at this track and over 1m.
runners.comment: 0-18; second in three of his last four starts but more to prove at this track and over 1m

runners.name: The Spotlight Kid
runners.spotlight: Both AW wins (his latest) were on Kempton Polytrack in November 2024; effective over C&D, edging down the weights and often not far away but others are preferred for win purposes.
runners.comment: Both AW wins November 2024; effective over C&D, edging down weights and often not far away

runners.name: Have You A Minute
runners.spotlight: C&D winner in 2024 and scored at Wolverhampton last October; finished last season on a downswing and well beaten at 40-1 for reappearance two months ago, which he might have needed but absent again since; market may guide.
runners.comment: C&D winner; well beaten at 40-1 for reappearance and absent again since

runners.name: Evelyn's Phoenix
runners.spotlight: 4-29 record includes a Nottingham win (1m) in April on reappearance but he's been out of form in recent outings; now makes his AW debut.
runners.comment: Won reappearance but out of form in recent outings; now makes his AW debut in 30th race

runners.name: Barleybrown
runners.spotlight: The last four of his five wins were over 1m on Newcastle Tapeta (hampered on sole start here); looked an unlucky loser at Newcastle on penultimate start but bled from the nose when a disappointing favourite there on latest; player if straight back to form.
runners.comment: Looked unlucky loser on penultimate start but bled from the nose when favourite on latest

runners.name: Tardaff
runners.spotlight: Second in two novice/maiden events last year but she's failed to beat a rival in any of her last four starts, including three handicaps this year.
runners.comment: Failed to beat a rival in any of her last four starts, including three handicaps this year

runners.name: Love You More
runners.spotlight: Benefited from the drop into 0-50 classified company when off the mark at the 14th attempt at Lingfield (1m, Polytrack) five weeks ago; more is needed on this return to a handicap and she has more to prove on Tapeta.
runners.comment: Lingfield classified win (1m, Polytrack) latest; more needed on this return to a handicap

runners.name: Heretic
runners.spotlight: First 27 starts came on the AW with three wins, including two over C&D last October; rather patchy this year but he was third of 13 when making his turf debut at Doncaster (7f) in May and probably not discredited in a two-runner turf race in June when last seen; in the mix.
runners.comment: Two C&D wins last October; rather patchy in 2026 but ran okay on turf last two; in the mix

runners.name: Splinterwood
runners.spotlight: Accomplished little in three novices, though he did attract the stewards' attention on third start; weakened into ninth of 13 when 22-1 for handicap debut at Wolverhampton (8.6f) on latest outing; all four were on Tapeta; down 2lb but no solid form.
runners.comment: Accomplished little in three novices and 8.6f handicap debut, all on Tapeta

runners.name: Mercurius Power
runners.spotlight: The last of his six wins was in August 2024 (C&D) but he's slipped in the weights and nearly took advantage at Newcastle (1m, Tapeta) on latest start; there's plenty this year to suggest he has each-way claims.
runners.comment: Slipped in the weights and nearly took advantage at Newcastle (1m, Tapeta) on latest start

runners.name: Implied Volatility
runners.spotlight: Yet to make the first three after 11 races from 6f to 1m2f; 18lb lower now than on last summer's handicap debut but others are more solid.
runners.comment: Yet to make the first three; 18lb lower now than on last summer's handicap debut

runners.name: Muddy Marvellous
runners.spotlight: Low-level form in all five starts, including one handicap (C&D last October); he was triple-figure odds for all of them, so the market has been a pretty good guide so far; seasonal debut.
runners.comment: Triple-figure odds for all five races (one handicap) and that has been a pretty good guide

runners.name: Create
runners.spotlight: Three C&D wins; competitive only twice in 2026 but latest instance saw her register a turf win at Ffos Las (1m) 19 days ago; player if backing that up.
runners.comment: Three C&D wins; competitive only twice in 2026 but latest run saw her register a turf win
runners.owner: Dixon, Wylam, M Baldry, J&s Harrod

races.race_name: LNAA Critical Care Novice Stakes (GBB Race) (Div I)

runners.name: Palladas
runners.spotlight: 750,000gns yearling by Lope De Vega; 6-5 for his debut in a 12-runner maiden at Kempton (1m, AW) in January and came from midfield to stride clear; the next two in that race have done well since; off 200 days but one of the two leading contenders on form and probably an exciting prospect.
runners.comment: 750,000gns yearling by Lope De Vega; 6-5 for stylish win at Kempton (1m, AW) in January

runners.name: Star Of The Desert
runners.spotlight: 50-1 second of 13 in C&D novice in June, always prominent, but his fourth of six at Carlisle (1m, good to firm) three weeks later was well below that form; a major contender if reverting to his debut form and his sire was a US dirt performer, so the return to AW may well suit.
runners.comment: 50-1 second in C&D novice; fourth at Carlisle (1m, good to firm) was well below that form

runners.name: Blue Boy Junior
runners.spotlight: Fair form when fourth at Thirsk (7f, good) and Carlisle (7f, soft) this spring, with the latter suggesting that 1m would help; however, much better is needed if he's to overturn today's form principals.
runners.comment: Fair form twice over 7f on turf this spring and 1m can help, but much better is needed

runners.name: Mercantile
runners.spotlight: Third foal; Night Of Thunder half-brother to winners Theory Of Tides (1m2f/11.4f; RPR 100) and Regalian (7f AW; 90); dam Australian 5f/6f winner (including 2yo Group 3; 108), sister to Australian 5f Group 2 winner; needs a check but probably finds himself in a warm race for debut.
runners.comment: By Night Of Thunder; 3rd foal; half-brother to two winners, one a useful 1m2f/11.4f winner

runners.name: Assiri Heights
runners.spotlight: 700,000gns yearling by Frankel; dam 5f/6f winner (including Listed; RPR 109); rather slowly into his stride on his way to a 20l defeat in novice at Salisbury (6f, good to firm) last July; presumably showed a lot more at home prior to that, as he started 5-4 favourite, and it will be interesting to see if his backers go in again on this belated return.
runners.comment: 700,000gns Frankel colt; showed little at Salisbury (6f) last July but was 5-4 favourite

runners.name: Salvezza
runners.spotlight: 9-2, very green early on in a novice at Nottingham (1m, good to firm) 17 days ago and left himself with a lot to do, unable to pass any of his four rivals; should do better but no claims yet.
runners.comment: 9-2, very green early at Nottingham (1m, good to firm) 17 days ago, always last thereafter

runners.name: Cullinan Wolf
runners.spotlight: 16-1 and 200-1 when behind at Doncaster (6f, good to firm) and Wolverhampton (7f, AW) this summer.
runners.comment: 16-1 and 200-1 when behind at Doncaster (6f) and Wolverhampton (7f, AW) this summer.

runners.name: Wyvill
runners.spotlight: Low-level form when 150-1 and slowly away at Leicester (1m, good) and Wolverhampton (9.4f, AW), so he looks one for handicaps in due course.
runners.comment: 150-1, slowly away for low-level form at Leicester (1m, good) and Wolverhampton (9.4f, AW)

runners.name: Wats On Tiger
runners.spotlight: Remote when 500-1 at Beverley (7.4f, good) in June, blowing the start.
runners.comment: Remote when 500-1 at Beverley (7.4f, good) in June, blowing the start

runners.name: Jetpack Jimmy
runners.spotlight: 66-1, always behind in novice at Newcastle (7f, AW) in June; has an extra 1f today but is bred for markedly further.
runners.comment: 66-1, always behind in novice at Newcastle (7f, AW) in June; bred for markedly further

races.race_name: LNAA Critical Care Novice Stakes (GBB Race) (Div II)

runners.name: Prosperity
runners.spotlight: Half-sister to the yard's smart Native Warrior; odds-on when defying greenness at Ripon 20 days ago (1m) and that was promising, for all that the second has since extended her losing streak to six; clear claims with improvement on the cards.
runners.comment: Beat a disappointing filly at Ripon but at odds-on she won with a nice bit in hand

runners.name: Savile Row
runners.spotlight: Showed a consistent level of form in four defeats (6f-7f) for Aidan O'Brien, whom he left for 24,000gns; has definite form claims but he's undergone wind surgery, sports new headgear (tried blinkers on second run) and has been off since October; market confidence would be welcomed.
runners.comment: 0-4 for Aidan O'Brien and sold on for 24,000gns; had wind op and sports new headgear

runners.name: Peaceful Spirit
runners.spotlight: She wasn't far away in a C&D maiden on second run in April 2025 on what proved her final race for Karl Burke; left that yard for 2,000gns.
runners.comment: Ran okay on final run for Karl Burke but in 2025 and later sold for 2,000gns

runners.name: Al Jolson
runners.spotlight: Night Of Thunder newcomer out of a Frankel mare who won over 1m2f on the AW (RPR 95); has been gelded but he cost 260,000gns as a yearling and is of obvious interest, all the more so if strong in the betting.
runners.comment: Night Of Thunder newcomer out of a Frankel mare who won over 1m2f on the AW (RPR 95)

runners.name: Sotto Il Sasso
runners.spotlight: 100,000euros yearling; ninth foal; closely related to 1m-1m1f winner La Signare (RPR 106) and half-brother to five winners including Le Baol (French 9.7f AW/1m4f turf Listed; 101) and Never Dies (French 7f 2yo; 92); dam 1m 2yo winner (90); would command respect if at all strong in the market.
runners.comment: 100,000euros yearling and well related; would command respect if at all strong in market

runners.name: Electric Gambler
runners.spotlight: Also tongue tied at Windsor (1m) where he was slowly away and always in rear; went off 33-1; no appeal after that.
runners.comment: Also tongue tied at Windsor (1m) where he was slowly away and always in rear

runners.name: Rua Mor
runners.spotlight: Finished third over hurdles in Ireland; beaten a shade under 10l in two 8.6f non-handicaps at Wolverhampton for this yard; very vulnerable.
runners.comment: Finished third over hurdles in Ireland; well held in two AW Flat races for current yard

runners.name: Majestic Ruler
runners.spotlight: 220,000gns yearling but didn't last long with Karl Burke, for whom he was tailed off in his only run over 6f at Newbury; gelded since changing hands for 5,000gns; can only be watched.
runners.comment: Tailed off in one run for Karl Burke and sold on for 5,000gns; now gelded

runners.name: Ze Gucci Poochie
runners.spotlight: 300-1 when beaten 25l over 7f here last month.
runners.comment: 300-1 when beaten 25l over 7f here last month

runners.name: My Prerogative
runners.spotlight: Down the field in one run over 6f for Ed Walker and tailed off over Nottingham's 1m on recent yard debut.
runners.comment: One run for Ed Walker; tailed off over Nottingham's 1m on recent yard debut

runners.name: Elite Approach
runners.spotlight: Out the back early before staying on to some effect when fourth of nine over 6f here in April; there's some ability lurking but he'd be a surprise winner of this.
runners.comment: Out the back early before staying on to some effect when fourth over 6f here in April

races.race_name: Coopers Marquees Handicap

runners.name: Shiplake
runners.spotlight: Impressed with two C&D wins during the winter and could leave subsequent struggles behind back on this surface; shouldn't be handicapped out of it.
runners.comment: Could leave subsequent struggles behind now back on this surface

runners.name: Sovereign Ocean
runners.spotlight: Contested last year's Group 3 Acomb in between wins over 7f (one at Wolverhampton); still lightly raced and denied only late on last time at Chester (7f) where he appeared to have that in the bag when kicking clear after disputing the lead throughout; that effort is worthy of an upgrade; interesting.
runners.comment: Lightly raced and still progressing judged on his unfortunate defeat at Chester

runners.name: Skipper
runners.spotlight: Won at Redcar (1m) in April on yard debut but has beaten just one rival in two outings since; cheekpieces are quickly swapped for blinkers; has something to prove all of a sudden but the ability is lurking to take a hand.
runners.comment: Cheekpieces are quickly swapped for blinkers; has something to prove all of a sudden

runners.name: Kisskodi
runners.spotlight: Took strike-rate to 5-16 when winning comfortably at Chepstow (7f, good to soft) ten weeks ago, looking better than ever; 7lb higher in this classier contest but has run well here before and he's not easily knocked.
runners.comment: Took strike-rate to 5-16 when winning comfortably at Chepstow; up 7lb; has form here

runners.name: Aurora Majesty
runners.spotlight: 2-3 on AW surfaces; he's on a handy mark on last season's best efforts and the signs were more encouraging at Thirsk 15 days ago (7f), as although only midfield he wasn't beaten all that far; others are still preferred.
runners.comment: Should be on a good mark and signs were more encouraging at Thirsk 15 days ago

runners.name: Utmost Good Faith
runners.spotlight: Won once in Ireland and three times for George Boughey, twice on the AW and in a 7f Epsom handicap on final start for that yard; later sold for 28,000gns; had always worn a hood (also effective in tongue-tie) but went in blinkers on stable debut at Goodwood recently and raced too freely up front; now goes in an eyeshield; bit risky.
runners.comment: Four-time winner; raced too freely at Goodwood on yard debut; more new headgear

runners.name: Willem Twee
runners.spotlight: All wins have been over 6f but he had solid 7f form for James Fanshawe; won't mind getting back on an AW surface but it was a very quiet stable debut at Windsor (50-1) three weeks ago.
runners.comment: Won't mind getting back on an AW surface but it was a very quiet stable debut at Windsor

runners.name: Dixieland Blues
runners.spotlight: First six runs were at 1m and he had been disappointing in handicaps; however, that changed when dropped to 7f at Kempton last September and he's well handicapped on that comfortable 2l win despite this 8lb higher mark; it's encouraging that he returns from his absence with the yard in great form.
runners.comment: 1-1 over 7f and well handicapped on that Kempton form in Sept; yard going well

runners.name: Divine Libra
runners.spotlight: Three-time winner but now on a lengthy losing run and connections reverted to blinkers last time at Goodwood; needs to turn a corner.
runners.comment: Now on a lengthy losing run and connections reverted to blinkers last time at Goodwood

runners.name: Tina's Indian
runners.spotlight: Won twice on turf in Ireland and had competitive form in a handicap at this trip; latest run there in a new tongue-tie was highly respectable and he could be interesting on yard debut with Billy Loughnane booked; AW debut.
runners.comment: Two wins in Ireland; could be interesting on yard debut with Billy Loughnane booked

runners.name: Legal Reform
runners.spotlight: A sixth win here when beating five rivals in March on latest outing (7f); went up only 2lb but lacking a recent run is probably not ideal in this much deeper race.
runners.comment: A sixth win here when beating five rivals in March on latest outing; went up only 2lb

runners.name: Great Dream
runners.spotlight: Won a 7f Tapeta maiden for the Crisfords and doubled his tally on third and final run for William Haggas when winning by 11l on soft ground at Ffos Las in June (first-time cheekpieces worn then are now removed); wouldn't want to be flattered by that having gone up 12lb; joined current connections last month for 30,000gns.
runners.comment: Up 12lb for 11l soft-ground win at Ffos Las and wouldn't want to be flattered by that

runners.name: Midnight Thunder
runners.spotlight: Won two turf novices as a 2yo, beating Wokingham winner Double Rush in the first; well below that level when confined to only two starts at Meydan in 2025 (both in January; one on AW); lots to prove on a few counts on handicap debut and with a tongue-tie tried, though any confidence behind him would turn some heads.
runners.comment: Classy at best; long absent but any confidence behind him would turn some heads

runners.name: Valvano
runners.spotlight: Has some flashes of smart form (including on sole AW start when second to Notable Speech) so it's disappointing that he's won just once in ten races, and more new headgear was tried when sixth on his reappearance in the Lincoln; that was a pretty good effort from off the pace and he returns from another break after wind surgery and with no aids fitted; has a fair record when fresh, so dangerous to dismiss.
runners.comment: Only 1-10 but has flashes of smart form; had a wind op since his sixth in the Lincoln

races.race_name: Grace & Dotty Maiden Stakes (GBB Race) (Div I)

runners.name: Space Party
runners.spotlight: Clear promise in both his runs over 6f, last time beaten half a length behind one who hasn't disgraced the form since; sets the standard.
runners.comment: Clear promise in both his runs over 6f and he sets the standard

runners.name: Storm Force
runners.spotlight: 230,000gns breeze-up buy last year; raced with choke out and was turned over at odds of 4-7 on debut at Hamilton (5f, good) that May; second run has been a long time coming and he's now gelded; market vibes are awaited with interest.
runners.comment: Raced freely when a short-priced failure on debut in May 2025; now gelded

runners.name: Atomik
runners.spotlight: First foal out of a 7f-8.6f AW winner (RPR 98) and half-sister to winners Revenite (6f 2yo) and Global Art (1m-1m2f); tongue tied for debut; she'd be a surprise winner unless the money comes.
runners.comment: First foal out of a 7f-8.6f AW winner; surprise winner unless the money comes

runners.name: Extended Credit
runners.spotlight: 85,000gns yearling; settled in rear at Wolverhampton (7f; 25-1) and never made any great inroads up the straight; best watched for now.
runners.comment: Settled in rear at Wolverhampton (7f) and never made any great inroads up the straight

runners.name: Persian Gate
runners.spotlight: 30,000gns yearling by Ardad; sixth foal; closely related to winners Yazaman (Group-placed 5f/5.5f; RPR 103) and Poderoso (Qatari 6f/7f), and half-brother to 5f-6.5f winner Royal Commando (114); dam Listed-placed 5f winner (105); gelded prior to this debut but pedigree bodes well.
runners.comment: 30,000gns yearling by Ardad; gelded prior to this debut but pedigree bodes well

runners.name: Iron Dome
runners.spotlight: Son of Blue Point who cost 80,000gns as a yearling; half-brother to 6f winner Thelma's Angel (RPR 88); dam Listed-placed 5f/5.4f winner (109); has been gelded but needs checking out in the betting.
runners.comment: Son of Blue Point who cost 80,000gns as a yearling; gelded; check him out in the betting.

runners.name: Blazing Gaden
runners.spotlight: Exposed as a limited hurdler and makes no appeal on this belated Flat debut.
runners.comment: Exposed as a limited hurdler and makes no appeal on this belated Flat debut

runners.name: Cosmic Bond
runners.spotlight: Has performed to a low level in both his races over 7f.
runners.comment: Has performed to a low level in both his races over 7f

runners.name: I Can Dream
