runners.spotlight: Out the back in races at Windsor and Bath; handicaps beckon; stablemate of form choice Space Party.
runners.comment: Out the back in races at Windsor and Bath; handicaps beckon; stablemate of Space Party

runners.name: Poison Arrow
runners.spotlight: £170,000 yearling; went off at only 7-2 for last year's debut at Windsor (6f, good) but never really got involved from off the pace; gelded in the meantime and it will be interesting to gauge the confidence behind him after 11 months off.
runners.comment: Never dangerous on last year's debut in September but went off at just 7-2

races.race_name: Grace & Dotty Maiden Stakes (GBB Race) (Div II)

runners.name: Yordan
runners.spotlight: 160,000gns yearling; weak 10-1 at Leicester (7f) but saw his race out well for second of four after starting slowly, and the winner had shown plenty of promise previously; this drop back to 6f wouldn't be an obvious move but he's a scopey gelding with better days ahead of him.
runners.comment: Second over 7f on debut and he's a scopey gelding with better days ahead of him

runners.name: Black Orchid
runners.spotlight: Well-bred filly who has finished second in both her races, beaten 7l on debut but then just over 2l at Wetherby (extended 5f) where she got no freedom up front; take out the winner and that was a weak race, but she retains potential.
runners.comment: Second again in a weak race last time but was pestered up front; retains some potential

runners.name: Cosmic Girl
runners.spotlight: 72,000gns yearling and a half-sister to four winners; also hooded at Lingfield in May (extended 7f, good) and ran with a degree of promise behind respected opposition; needs to find more but that's feasible, especially back at 6f as she travelled okay on that debut.
runners.comment: Travelled well but didn't get home over an extended 7f on debut; back in trip here

runners.name: Oddjob
runners.spotlight: 40,000gns yearling and a half-brother to four winners; made his debut over 7f on Tapeta at Wolverhampton (14-1) where he didn't enjoy the clearest of runs before keeping on, finishing 7l off the winner; the runner-up has given that form a hefty boost; should be wiser here and get involved, for all that dropping back to 6f may ask different questions of him.
runners.comment: This drop back to 6f may ask different questions but 7f debut was encouraging

runners.name: Mr G Force
runners.spotlight: Son of Frankel but never raced for Godolphin after making 500,000gns as a yearling and was sold on this February for 16,000gns (gelded before then); a watching brief makes sense.
runners.comment: Godolphin cast-off who changed hands for 16,000gns in February

runners.name: Beautiful Rumour
runners.spotlight: First foal out of a 5f/6f winner for this yard, including on the Newcastle AW; however, this is a belated debut and he's probably up against it.
runners.comment: First foal out of a 5f/6f winner for this yard, including on Newcastle AW; belated debut

runners.name: Project Wallace
runners.spotlight: Went from the front when beaten 2l at Newcastle and had a wide draw when not so good at Wolverhampton (again over 5f; did some hanging); others in here have superior form but he'll win races further down the line, if not this one.
runners.comment: Others in here have superior form but he'll win races further down the line

runners.name: El Ghuwah
runners.spotlight: Both runs over 5f; his third last time came in a field of four and he was beaten just over 8l, as was also the case on his debut.
runners.comment: Both runs over 5f; his third last time came in a field of four and beaten just over 8l

runners.name: Smooth Flight
runners.spotlight: Beaten in the region of 15l in 6f races at Lingfield and Wolverhampton; one for handicaps.
runners.comment: Beaten in the region of 15l in 6f races at Lingfield and Wolverhampton; one for handicaps

races.race_name: GB Civil Engineering Apprentice Handicap (Apprentice Training Race - Racing Excellence Series)

runners.name: Big Apple Jack
runners.spotlight: No wins in 14 but twice runner-up this year over 6f and tried 7f last time, running another fair race; could drop lucky one day.
runners.comment: No wins in 14 but twice runner-up this year and could drop lucky one day

runners.name: Toptime
runners.spotlight: Made all at Nottingham (5f, soft) and bang there on starts either side of that, beaten under a length; solid chance with C&D form to his name.
runners.comment: Made all at Nottingham (5f, soft) and bang there on starts either side of that

runners.name: On Key
runners.spotlight: Only 1-26 but that win was three runs back over 7f at Wolverhampton and it had been coming; has continued to run well and 6f is fine, as is this track.
runners.comment: Only 1-26 but that win was three runs back over 7f at Wolverhampton and it had been coming

runners.name: Southern Warrior
runners.spotlight: Won off 3lb higher over 6f on the AW for previous yard; unplaced so far for current one, offering little in last two races.
runners.comment: Unplaced so far for current stable, offering little in last two races

runners.name: Starsong
runners.spotlight: Inconsistency has crept in but she ran really well from a bad draw at Pontefract last time (6f) and has won here before.
runners.comment: Good run from a bad draw at Pontefract last time and she's won here before

runners.name: Massimo Blue
runners.spotlight: New trainer decides against the cheekpieces (and regular tongue-tie) that worked well for this 4yo in his last two races, when he had the outside stall at Kempton and raced wide throughout at Wolverhampton (again over 6f); C&D winner with a good chance.
runners.comment: Last two efforts can be upgraded; C&D winner; good chance on yard debut

runners.name: Orange Emperor
runners.spotlight: No wins in nine; has gone close in 6f/7f handicaps (one on Polytrack) but prone to off days, as he reminded us last time at Yarmouth.
runners.comment: Has gone close in 6f/7f handicaps (one on Polytrack) but prone to off days, as last time

runners.name: Tough Enough
runners.spotlight: Three-time winner but 0-13 since moving yards and doesn't look about to put that right.
runners.comment: Three-time winner but 0-13 since moving yards and doesn't look about to put that right

runners.name: Ahead Of Fashion
runners.spotlight: Regressive maiden who continues to race freely, so dropping back from 7f might be no bad thing; wouldn't be the percentage play, though.
runners.comment: Maiden who continues to race freely, so dropping back from 7f might be no bad thing

runners.name: Great Success
runners.spotlight: Left the Faheys for 3,500gns as an eight-race maiden; needs to halt the slide in his form.
runners.comment: Left the Faheys for 3,500gns as an eight-race maiden; needs to halt the slide in form

runners.name: Blackjack
runners.spotlight: Has won on turf but better on the AW and gave it a good go under a front-running ride last month at Wolverhampton (7f; just behind On Key); better known for his exploits at this trip; an exposed 9yo but not without hope.
runners.comment: Gave it a good go from the front last month at Wolverhampton (7f); better at 6f

runners.name: Lesley's Boy
runners.spotlight: Best form was as a 2yo when twice successful; falling in the weights but this season hasn't got up and running.
runners.comment: Useful 2yo; falling in the weights but this season hasn't got up and running

runners.name: Federal Envoy
runners.spotlight: All three wins have been here but over 7f and for different yards; however, close up on stable debut over 6f at Ripon and last run wasn't too bad as he was never in the right place at Lingfield; don't put a line through him.
runners.comment: Three-time winner here over 7f; two of his runs for this yard not devoid of promise

runners.name: Torfrida
runners.spotlight: Sole win was in 2023 but she's lightly raced for a 6yo; ran on late over 5f here two months ago when making AW debut after nearly a year off; if sharper for that, and returning to her winning trip, she should go well.
runners.comment: Encouraging return here over 5f and sole win was over this longer distance

races.race_name: Tramore Directors Maiden Hurdle

runners.name: Captain Hanley
runners.spotlight: Runner-up in maiden hurdles at Clonmel (2m4f) in May and Punchestown (3m) in June; not so good the last twice back in trip and has it to do here.
runners.comment: Best form over further, remains opposable

runners.name: Penzance
runners.spotlight: Not the force of old (one-time useful AW handicapper) but runner-up in modest maiden hurdle company in Britain this summer at Stratford (twice) and after making most (carrying head awkwardly, hung right) at Worcester (2m, good); no show on handicap debut at Galway and back into maiden company probably with a bit to find.
runners.comment: Placed in modest maiden company in Britain, this likely tougher

runners.name: Speed For Fun
runners.spotlight: Won on the Flat in France last year (1m2f, soft) and had Listowel maiden hurdle (2m4f, good to yielding) at his mercy before last-flight fall on stable debut in May; clear second to an odds-on shot at Cartmel last month (2m1f), having been clear for much of the way; hood now fitted and likely the one to beat.
runners.comment: Shown winning potential on both hurdle runs; hood now fitted and likely the one to beat

runners.name: Louiescall
runners.spotlight: Fair sort on the Flat, winning 1m7f Leopardstown handicap last summer, albeit latest two efforts have been well below his best; 0-6 hurdling, narrowly beaten in C&D maiden at this meeting last year his best effort; chance if returning to that sort of form.
runners.comment: Out of form on Flat of late but C&D second at last year's meeting puts him in the mix

runners.name: Ballybollen
runners.spotlight: Nathaniel half-brother to four winners, notably useful bumper and hurdles performer Mongibello; dam French 1m1f/10.5f winner, half-sister to French 2m5f Grade 3 hurdle winner; beaten favourite but showed some promise on debut in Ballinrobe bumper last month; quickly switches to hurdles.
runners.comment: Beaten favourite but showed promise on debut in Ballinrobe bumper; switches to hurdles

runners.name: Ivatt
runners.spotlight: Ghaiyyath 4yo ran to a useful level of form on the Flat last year for Charlie Fellows at around 1m4f; yard debut effort at Galway was respectable, considering he was plenty fresh; interesting now switched to hurdles and one to consider.
runners.comment: Useful Flat maiden all the better for recent comeback run; could make his mark hurdling

runners.name: Bobby Kirova
runners.spotlight: Some promise in Flat maidens last year but has been disappointing in handicaps this term; hurdles debut was a bit more encouraging when third in 2m2f Sligo maiden, despite some novicey jumping, but didn't improve at Kilbeggan; drops in trip here.
runners.comment: Sligo debut effort not built on at Kilbeggan; drops in trip here

runners.name: Grabat
runners.spotlight: Soundly beaten on debut in Kilbeggan bumper and none too fluent on hurdles debut at Killarney last month; can only be watched for now.
runners.comment: None too fluent on hurdles debut at Killarney last month; can only be watched for now

runners.name: Cairo King
runners.spotlight: Very lightly raced in Britain, initially with Alan King and then in two runs at Stratford for Jamie Snowdon, latter occasion when last in 2m maiden hurdle in May 2024; tongue-tied on debut for Andy Slattery and watching brief advised.
runners.comment: Nothing in three runs in Britain; long-absent and likely best watched

runners.name: Sankofa
runners.spotlight: Promise on debut in Curraghmore point-to-point in April but never travelled after being badly hampered halfway on hurdles debut at Cork early this month when a 40-1 shot; best watched.
runners.comment: Never travelled after being badly hampered halfway on hurdles debut at Cork; best watched

races.race_name: Frank Gillane Memorial Handicap Hurdle

runners.name: Surviving Murmansk
runners.spotlight: Sole win came in this race last year off the same mark; not bad efforts at Cork and Kilbeggan lately so has to enter calculations back at this venue.
runners.comment: Won this last year; not bad efforts lately so has to enter calculations back at this venue

runners.name: Truckers Cruising
runners.spotlight: A heavy ground chase winner last winter ran one of his best hurdle races at this track in 2024; not a bad run in a claimer last time and could go well.
runners.comment: Chase winner; not a bad run in a claimer last time and could go well
runners.owner: Ed Mulligan & John Finnegan & Aileen Saunders & Ann Holton

runners.name: Pahlavi
runners.spotlight: Has been badly regressive over hurdles this year and was withdrawn on the Flat recently after being unruly before the start; not easy to fancy.
runners.comment: Has been badly regressive over hurdles this year and isn't easy to fancy

runners.name: Glendower
runners.spotlight: Maiden under both codes has been running well enough in defeat lately but he has run poorly both starts at this course so questions in that respect.
runners.comment: Some fair runs lately; has run poorly both starts here so questions in that respect

runners.name: Owl's Delight
runners.spotlight: Well beaten in a bumper and four maiden hurdles but should do better now in handicaps.
runners.comment: Well beaten in a bumper and four maiden hurdles but should do better now in handicaps

runners.name: Doyen Og
runners.spotlight: Maiden has run well enough last two starts with blinkers added but has to find more down 1lb.
runners.comment: Maiden has run well enough last two starts with blinkers added; has to find more down 1lb

runners.name: Cinnabar Moth
runners.spotlight: Solid efforts on first two handicap runs but was poor at Wexford last time when raced keenly with a hood on; that is left off today and could run well if settling; beaten around 9l here on Friday.
runners.comment: Poor at Wexford last time with a hood on; without it when beaten around 9l here on Friday

runners.name: Annie's Angel
runners.spotlight: Won as a 2yo on the Flat; some decent efforts in defeat mixing both codes lately but needs to find more on this second handicap hurdle start.
runners.comment: Dual-purpose mare; needs to find more on this second handicap hurdle start
runners.owner: Conor O'Connor & Colum Currie & Mark Devenny

runners.name: Depeche Mo
runners.spotlight: Maiden in all spheres has been placed a few times but is coming back from a layoff so others are preferred.
runners.comment: Has been placed a few times but is coming back from a layoff so others are preferred

runners.name: Doctor Confusion
runners.spotlight: Showed glimpses of promise in maidens but has been poor in two handicap starts; can't be ruled out from this top yard but a tongue-tie will have to make a significant difference.
runners.comment: Can't be ruled out from this yard but a tongue-tie will have to make a major difference

runners.name: Ina Mina
runners.spotlight: A wide-margin Flat winner here in 2025 got off the mark over hurdles on return at Cork last time, still showing greenness; a 13lb hike is plenty but has to be considered with more to come.
runners.comment: Course Flat winner; up 13lb for her Cork hurdle win but still has to be considered

runners.name: Vairue
runners.spotlight: Sole hurdle win came in 2022; not many runs since and fell early at Cork last time; isn't high on the list.
runners.comment: Sole hurdle win came in 2022; fell early at Cork last time; isn't high on the list

runners.name: Maxios Lady
runners.spotlight: Showed little in maidens and was pulled-up on handicap debut at Listowel last year so not easy to fancy.
runners.comment: Showed little in maidens and was pulled-up on handicap debut at Listowel last year

runners.name: Lanzhou
runners.spotlight: Second runner for yard; some promise in points; modest in maiden hurdles but travelled strongly before weakening over 2m5f on handicap debut here three days ago; this trip can suite better, notable jockey booking so one to consider.
runners.comment: Weakened over 2m5f on h'cap debut here 3 days ago; this trip can suit better; one to note

runners.name: Colesberg
runners.spotlight: The best of four maiden hurdle runs came at Kilbeggan last time; can do better now in handicaps and local yard targets this meeting so is worth checking the market.
runners.comment: Can do better now in handicaps; local yard targets this meeting so check the market

races.race_name: Frank King Memorial Maiden Hurdle

runners.name: Goodmancon
runners.spotlight: Ran well at times in bumpers without winning, including here; some solid efforts in four maiden hurdles but has fallen once and didn't jump that well last time so needs to do better.
runners.comment: Some solid efforts over hurdles but has fallen once and didn't jump that well last time

runners.name: Market Ready
runners.spotlight: Has posted several solid efforts in defeat over hurdles, with best form coming at Clonmel; however, was pulled-up in a tongue-tie at Killarney last time but that is left off today so can rebound.
runners.comment: Pulled-up in a tongue-tie at Killarney last time but that is left off today so can rebound

runners.name: Lady Lena
runners.spotlight: Solid efforts in bumpers at Listowel and Wexford last autumn, beaten a head on latter occasion, both over 2m; is likely to be well prepared for this return and has the stamina in her pedigree for this trip; a major player.
runners.comment: Placed in both bumpers; likely to be well prepared for this return and is a major player

runners.name: Something Fabulous
runners.spotlight: Runner-up on sole point start before winning a 2m bumper at this meeting last year on second rules start; was poor in soft ground in a Listed bumper on sole 2026 run but has to be respected back here on hurdles debut on good ground; penalised 8lb, though.
runners.comment: Bumper winner here last year; has to be respected back here on hurdles debut

runners.name: L'As de Watt
runners.spotlight: Runner-up in a Cork maiden hurdle last November but no sign of that form in three runs since; the tongue-tie will have to make a major difference.
runners.comment: Runner-up in a Cork maiden hurdle last November; no sign of that form in three runs since

runners.name: Thelittleredfox
runners.spotlight: Well beaten in a Killarney bumper on debut and can only be watched for the time being.
runners.comment: Well beaten in a Killarney bumper on debut and can only be watched for the time being

runners.name: South Of Killerig
runners.spotlight: Has shown some ability in bumpers and maiden hurdles but has been pulled-up in two points this year; has to return to best for a new yard with cheekpieces added.
runners.comment: PU in two points this year; has to return to best for a new yard with cheekpieces added

runners.name: Eyecanboogie
runners.spotlight: Modest form in bumpers and three maiden hurdles so handicaps will suit better after today.
runners.comment: Modest form in bumpers and three maiden hurdles so handicaps will suit better after today

runners.name: Ajp Falco
runners.spotlight: Ran well enough before falling in a 3m Punchestown maiden hurdle two starts ago but was well beaten at Cork since; others preferred.
runners.comment: Ran well enough before falling in a 3m Punchestown maiden but well beaten at Cork since

runners.name: Flowing Fast
runners.spotlight: Second runner for yard; didn't progress in seven points and well beaten at Cork on hurdling debut so best watched today.
runners.comment: Didn't progress in points and well beaten at Cork on hurdling debut so best watched today

races.race_name: Victoria House Tramore Mares Beginners Chase

runners.name: La Note Verte
runners.spotlight: Second runner for yard; dual hurdle winner is rated 123 in that sphere; fine efforts in both chase starts including when just behind stablemate Future Prospect at Wexford last time; her previous Killarney run was over 2m5f so this trip should be fine; big player.
runners.comment: Just behind Future Prospect at Wexford last time; seems to stay 2m5f so a big player

runners.name: Future Prospect
runners.spotlight: One of three runners for yard; point, bumper and maiden hurdle winner fell on chasing debut at this venue but has been runner-up twice since at Wexford over 2m and 2m3f; just in front of stablemate La Note Verte last time; a big player if staying this trip.
runners.comment: Just in front of stablemate La Note Verte last time; a big player if staying this trip

runners.name: Straight Home
runners.spotlight: Third runner for yard; point and bumper winner hit form over hurdles last year, winning twice and getting to a rating of 127; seems to be the stable third string on return/chasing debut but can still give a good account.
runners.comment: Seems to be the stable third string on return/chasing debut but can still run well

runners.name: Carry On Heidi
runners.spotlight: Dual point winner won a Clonmel maiden hurdle over 2m4f last autumn; posted some fine runs in defeat after in Listed and Grade 3 company; has to be respected on chasing debut even after a break.
runners.comment: Ran well in defeat in Listed and Grade 3 company hurdle company; respected on chase bow

runners.name: Miss Fourie
runners.spotlight: Bumper and dual hurdle winner is rated 121 in that sphere though disappointed when last seen in 2025; makes chasing debut for a new yard and is respected but ran poorly on her only run at this track last year.
runners.comment: Chasing bow for a new yard and is respected but ran poorly on her only run at this track

runners.name: Ellens Pride
runners.spotlight: Point winner is a maiden over hurdles and rated only 86 in that sphere so has a lot to find on chasing debut.
runners.comment: Maiden over hurdles and rated only 86 in that sphere so has a lot to find on chasing debut

runners.name: Costanuci
runners.spotlight: Course winner over hurdles has been running well enough in that sphere lately; some decent efforts amongst her eight chase runs and needs to be at her best returned to this discipline.
runners.comment: Some decent efforts amongst her eight chase runs and needs to be at her best

runners.name: Liss Eile
runners.spotlight: Maiden is rated only 77 over hurdles so can't be fancied in this company on chasing debut.
runners.comment: Is rated only 77 over hurdles so can't be fancied in this company on chasing debut

races.race_name: McCarthy's Irish Bar Lexington Handicap Chase

runners.name: Orkneys Jack
runners.spotlight: Point winner has only had six runs under rules; promising Kilbeggan chasing debut but not as good twice since; however, can do better again now entering handicaps.
runners.comment: Promising Kilbeggan chasing debut but not as good twice since; can do better now

runners.name: Nastya
runners.spotlight: Won over 3m at Limerick on return, her second chase win, but was poor at Wexford since and has to rebound; was disappointing on her only previous run here.
runners.comment: Won at Limerick on return but was poor at Wexford since and has to rebound

runners.name: A Snow White Park
runners.spotlight: Hurdle winner has twice run well in defeat at this track over fences this year, including over C&D; unseated at Galway last time but has a squeak on those better earlier runs.
runners.comment: Unseated at Galway last time but some decent chase runs previously including here

runners.name: That's About Right
runners.spotlight: Three hurdle wins; dual chase winner at Thurles; ran well enough at Galway last time but needs to do more today even dropped 2lb.
runners.comment: Dual chase winner ran well enough at Galway last time but needs to do more today

runners.name: Pourquoi Poi
runners.spotlight: Hurdle winner ran well enough on h'cap chase debut at Punchestown but was poor over hurdles last time at Ballinrobe; the cheekpieces worn then are left off today so he could rebound.
runners.comment: Ran well enough on h'cap chase debut at Punchestown but was poor over hurdles last time

runners.name: Intense Approach
runners.spotlight: Five-time hurdle winner won a Galway beginners' chase last year but hasn't been as good since; however, there was more encouragement at Kilbeggan last time and he drops in class today so isn't dismissed.
runners.comment: Won a Galway beginners' chase last year but hasn't been as good since; drops in class

runners.name: Watch The Weather
runners.spotlight: Dual chase winner was second over hurdles at Killarney in May and ran a cracker back over fences at Galway last time; looks a big player down 2lb and in grade.
runners.comment: Dual chase winner ran a cracker at Galway last time and is a big player down 2lb

runners.name: General Clermont
runners.spotlight: Dual chase winner has run well in defeat at this track; however, was pulled-up on his last chase run and below form over hurdles since so others preferred.
runners.comment: Pulled-up on last chase run and below form over hurdles since so others preferred

runners.name: Marv Michael
runners.spotlight: Maiden hurdle winner here; both chase wins came at Kilbeggan when with Henry de Bromhead; below form last four starts and needs a return to his best.
runners.comment: Maiden hurdle winner here; both chase wins came at Kilbeggan; below form lately

runners.name: Tullyveery Lad
runners.spotlight: Won this race last year but has been mostly below form this year over hurdles and fences; is still 3lb above last year's winning mark so has to return to best.
runners.comment: Won this race last year but has been mostly below form this year and has to return to best
runners.owner: Pat Tennyson & N P Morrissey & Raymond Micheal Cody

races.race_name: Heinz Pollmeier Memorial Handicap Chase

runners.name: Polly Poppins
runners.spotlight: A 15-race maiden but her best form has come here; beaten 3.5l into third by well-handicapped rival over C&D in October off 7lb higher; below form three starts this term but she would have a big chance if reproducing October effort.
runners.comment: A 15-race maiden but best form has come here; good C&D third in Oct; definite chance

runners.name: Presenting Lad
runners.spotlight: Six-time winner, including over C&D in a novice chase two years ago; form has been in and out over the last 12 months but best effort in that time came over C&D when 4.25l second off 4lb higher in May; below form last twice, pulled up at Wexford 47 days ago; on a good mark if return to this track sparks him up again.
runners.comment: C&D winner; second over C&D in May off 4lb higher; poor last twice but enjoys the track

runners.name: Katherine
runners.spotlight: Three-time winner over hurdles, latest in October 2024; last two hurdle runs have been poor and was well-held 2lb higher in handicap chase at Roscommon in June; needs plenty more in first-time hood.
runners.comment: Three-time hurdle winner; out of form of late over both obstacles; needs more

runners.name: Itsalonglongroad
runners.spotlight: Veteran who is 12-115 under all codes; five-time course winner, four times over jumps; dual C&D winner, latest 12 months ago off 7lb higher; much below best last two vists here but dangerous to completely write off in a winnable race at a venue he loves.
runners.comment: Five-time course winner, dual C&D; below best here last twice but can't write off

runners.name: Ballinaboola Gold
runners.spotlight: A 14-race maiden but has had some good efforts, most notably when second at Punchestown (3m, good) in May off 4lb higher; well-held in four starts since and tries a shorter trip over fences; capable off this mark.
runners.comment: 14-race maiden, best effort second at Punchestown in May; tries fences and shorter trip

runners.name: Kingdom Calling
runners.spotlight: 250-1 maiden hurdle winner two years ago; couple of decent runs in handicaps last year but form largely inconsistent; beaten 15l into fourth at Killarney (2m1f, good) 31 days ago over hurdles, staying on reasonably well from rear; beaten 21l over C&D in May; on a nice mark but needs to put best foot forward.
runners.comment: Maiden hurdle winner; form inconsistent since; decent fourth 31 days ago; on nice mark

runners.name: Bossing It
runners.spotlight: Maiden hurdle winner last year who bounced back to form with second at Wexford (2m1f, good) in May; backed that up when beaten 6l into fifth at Listowel when out of the weights; below form when beaten favourite at Wexford lto; makes chase debut and appeals as the type with more to give.
runners.comment: Maiden winner, returning to form prior to below-par effort lto; chase debut; more to give

runners.name: Robin Elite
runners.spotlight: Point-to-point winner last year but has struggled in handicap chases; well beaten at Killarney 30 days ago; drops in trip.
runners.comment: Point winner struggled in handicap chases; well beaten 30 days ago; drops in trip

runners.name: Nobody
runners.spotlight: Has been struggling in handicaps but ran one of his better races 13 days ago when keeping on to finish fifth at Cork (2m1f, good); needs fences to spark improvement.
runners.comment: Struggling in h'caps but ran a better race at Cork lto; needs fences to bring improvement

runners.name: Ray Gun
runners.spotlight: AW winner in Britain; hasn't shown anything of note in six hurdle starts; needs far more on chase debut
runners.comment: AW winner; not shown anything of note in six hurdle starts; makes chase debut

races.race_name: Irish Stallion Farms EBF Mares INH Flat Race

runners.name: The Two Mary's
runners.spotlight: Didn't complete in two point-to-points but outran odds when third past the post (demoted to fourth) at Galway 14 days ago; she was probably flattered by proximity but the first two are potentially smart so it was a positive effort; good chance here in winnable race.
runners.comment: Positive debut when fourth at Galway behind potentially smart rivals; good chance

runners.name: Myluckymaker
runners.spotlight: Stepped forward with each of her three stars for Adrian Murray; 8l second to subsequent winner at Clonmel (2m4f, yielding) 124 days ago having raced with enthusiasm in the lead in first-time hood; looks solid form and drop in trip should help on stable debut; hood left off; leading player.
runners.comment: Plenty keen when 8l second at Clonmel; form looks solid; stable debut; leading chance

runners.name: Bluebell Breeze
runners.spotlight: Decent fourth over C&D on debut but followed up with poor effort at Cork; more like it last time when beaten 15.5l into seventh at Galway (extended 2m, good) keeping on; each-way shout.
runners.comment: C&D fourth on debut a decent effort, as was Galway run last time; ew chance if building

runners.name: Frau Blucher
runners.spotlight: 3,000euros foal by Blue Bresil; dam unraced half-sister to winners Croco Bay (smart 2m-2m3f hurdle/chase) and Thistle Do Nicely (useful bumper and 2m-2m4f hurdle/chase); yard had bumper winner here in May.
runners.comment: Dam half-sister to smart Croco Bay and bumper winner; yard had bumper winner here in May

runners.name: Moot Hall
runners.spotlight: Dam unraced half-sister to 2m chase winner Majorica King and French 1m7f hurdle/2m1f chase winner Six Fois Sept, out of Listed-placed 1m2f winner; market can dictate expectations on debut.
runners.comment: Dam half-sister to two 2m chase winners; market can dictate expectations

runners.name: Winnie McGoogan
runners.spotlight: Elusive Pimpernel mare; half-sister to point winner Break The Boundary; dam point winner, half-sister to 5f 2yo winner Cloudea; not an obvious type on paper to make a winning debut.
runners.comment: Half-sister to point winner, dam a point winner; not an obvious type to make winning debut

runners.name: A Chairde Go Leir
runners.spotlight: A 1,400 euros foal; dam unraced half-sister to 3m hurdle/chase winner Lunar Contact, out of unraced sister to Champion Bumper and smart 2m2f-2m4f hurdle/chase winner Briar Hill; decent pedigree and market can guide on debut.
runners.comment: Dam unraced half-sister to 3m winner, out of sister to Briar Hill; market can guide

runners.name: Anna Quaintance
runners.spotlight: A 12,000euros foal; half-sister to Czech 6f 2yo winner Dantawi; unraced dam closely related to useful 7f/1m winner Akira, half-sister to 1m1f Flat/2m hurdle winner Halling Gal, out of unraced half-sister to 1m2f Group 3 winner Husyan; bred to be sharp; yard gets bumper winners.
runners.comment: Half-sister to Czech 6f 2yo winner; dam related to 7f/1m winner; yard gets bumper winners

runners.name: Lockeen Rose
runners.spotlight: Slipped up when struggling on debut at Thurles; off 239 days; hard to fancy.
runners.comment: Slipped up when struggling on debut at Thurles; off 239 days; hard to fancy

runners.name: Village Dream
runners.spotlight: Half-sister to some smart performers; showed ability when making late headway to be beaten 11.5l into fifth on debut at Killarney 31 days ago; hails from top yard; improvement expected and should be thereabouts.
runners.comment: Late headway beaten 11.5l on debut 31 days ago; top yard and improvement expected

runners.name: Super Freak
runners.spotlight: Showed ability on debut when beaten 16l in good Galway bumper a year ago; backwards step when returned from long absence at Killarney 31 days ago, beaten 21l; market expected better; should come on for that and not to be dismissed based on debut.
runners.comment: Positive debut a year ago but well below that on return last month; should improve

runners.name: Pamelaisbrass
runners.spotlight: Didn't show a great deal in first three runs but much improved when beaten 4.5l into sixth at Sligo (extended 2m2f, good) 10 days ago; could be flattered by that however and needs to build on it.
runners.comment: Improved form when beaten 4.5l at Sligo lto; might be flattered by that run

races.race_name: The Aga Khan Studs Prix Lady O'Reilly (Prix Minerve) (Group 3) (Turf)

runners.name: Romantic Symphony
runners.spotlight: From a good family and only modest effort came when when favourite for Lingfield Oaks Trial in the spring, but in decent form either side of that, following a second to Calasita in a Listed event (1m4f, good) in June with a Listed win at Newmarket (1m4f, good to firm) two weeks ago; stable in form.
runners.comment: From a good family and only one modest effort; stable in form

runners.name: Habibi
runners.spotlight: Won twice as a 2yo and gone close in Listed, Group 2 and Group 1 company this campaign, her most recent run seeing her 3.25l fourth in the Prix de Diane (1m2f110yds, good to firm); anything like that sort of form on her first try at this trip (some stamina in her pedigree) would see her a leading player for this.
runners.comment: Career best fourth in the Prix de Diane last time; tries new trip

runners.name: Dispatches
runners.spotlight: Won three is a row, which included beating Calasita a length at Compiegne in May in a conditions race; hat-trick was landed in a Listed event at Longchamp (1m2f, good to soft) before being beaten by a top prospect at the same track in a Group 2 on first try over 1m4f; likely to be involved.
runners.comment: Beat Calasita a length in May and likely to be involved

runners.name: Venetia
runners.spotlight: Improved this season upped in trip, winning on her handicap debut at Ascot and picking up a 1m2f soft-ground Listed race on soft at Goodwood in June when cheekpieces were first tried; 50-1 and well beaten in the Ribblesdale Stakes (1m4f, good to firm) but may don better off a break and down in grade; likes to go from the front.
runners.comment: Well beaten in the Ribblesdale Stakes last time; can front run

runners.name: Proxima Du Centaur
runners.spotlight: Kept some good company since winning here on the AW in November but has finished behind Dispatches the last two times they've met, including over this trip, so work to do with that rival.
runners.comment: Finished behind Dispatches the last two times, so more needed

runners.name: Hatanka Fal
runners.spotlight: Solid performer this season and not beaten far by some classy types following a couple of wins at the start of the year; close to her best in a 1m2f soft-ground Listed race at Vichy just over three weeks ago, and a good effort couldn't be ruled out.
runners.comment: Solid performer who picked up a career best last time; can run well

runners.name: Calasita
runners.spotlight: Zarak half-sister to winners, chief among them Calandagan, and won two of her three starts over 1m4f, the most recent a Listed success from Romantic Symphony a couple of months ago on good ground, with the defeat coming behind Dispatches; holds Group 1 entries and capable of more improvement.
runners.comment: Half-sister to Calandagan; trip plus going are fine and should have more to come

races.race_name: The Aga Khan Studs Prix Francois Boutin (Group 3) (Turf)

runners.name: Silver Dominion
runners.spotlight: Debut winner at Newbury (6.5f, good to soft) before a step up in form to be fourth in a Group 2 at Newmarket (7f, good to firm); didn't build on that dropped into Listed company after but beginning to shape like a solid performer and should be thereabouts.
runners.comment: Shaping like a solid performer and should give a good account

runners.name: Cut A Dash
runners.spotlight: Won well on debut at York's Dante meeting (5f, good) and then went on to be fourth in the Coventry at Royal Ascot (6f, good to firm); not so good in the Richmond Stakes after but can forgive a modest effort at Goodwood; enough in pedigree to suggest 7f won't be a problem if bouncing back.
runners.comment: Not at best last time but chance on previous form

runners.name: Jassas
runners.spotlight: Supplemented for this; holds Group 1 entries and made a winning debut at Doncaster just over three weeks ago (7f, good to firm) from a colt who won next time; could be anything.
runners.comment: Supplemented for this; could be anything after debut success

runners.name: Avec Toi
runners.spotlight: Won on debut by 4l at this trip on soft ground and then picked up a Listed event here over 7f on the Round Course from the front when last seen a month and a half ago; that form looks solid and he might be hard to pass.
runners.comment: Two from two and looked good last time; solid chance

runners.name: Zakkan
runners.spotlight: Only made debut in late June and not made much progress yet, although was beaten under a length over C&D a week ago; hard task to get first win in this race.
runners.comment: Not beaten far over C&D recent but hard race to get first win

races.race_name: The Aga Khan Studs Prix Jacques le Marois (Group 1) (Turf)

runners.name: More Thunder
runners.spotlight: Group 2 winner at Newbury last summer who posted solid efforts in Group 1 company on next three starts; failed to confirm Queen Anne placings with Zeus Olympios in steadily run Summer Mile at Ascot last time and he'll likely go well, especially if the gallop is honest.
runners.comment: Running well since Group 2 Newbury success a year ago; suited by a decent gallop

runners.name: Precise
runners.spotlight: Disappointed in the 1,000 Guineas but bounced back to win the Irish equivalent and followed up in the Coronation Stakes; creditable second to Blue Bolt in both the Falmouth and Rothschild; tends to lose ground at the start but likely to go well getting the fillies' allowance on this first run against the boys.
runners.comment: Triple Group 1 winner; posted solid efforts behind Blue Bolt on last two runs; claims

runners.name: Zeus Olympios
runners.spotlight: Unraced at two but created a fine impression last year, winning all four starts, including a convincing defeat of subsequent Group 1 winner Opera Ballo in the Joel Stakes; yet to match that form but not far off best when winning Group 2 at Ascot last time (better placed than More Thunder in a steadily run race); big chance back up in grade.
runners.comment: Unbeaten in 2025; yet to match pick of those efforts but won a Group 2 last time; claims
runners.owner: Exors Of The Late Sheikh Mohammed Obaid

runners.name: Thesecretadversary
runners.spotlight: Held in both the English/Irish 2,000 Guineas and best form has been around 7f but does stay this trip and has shown improved form to win the Jersey and Group 1 Jean Prat on last two starts; may find one or two too strong back over this trip, though.
runners.comment: Improved form to win Jersey/Jean Prat on last two starts; more to do back at 1m, though
runners.owner: Cayton Park Stud & Mrs John Magnier

runners.name: Rayif
runners.spotlight: 3-5 and turned in a clear pb to win the French 2,000 Guineas in May; failed to match that over 7f on quick ground behind Thesecretadversary in the Jean Prat but that proved his effectiveness on a sound surface and the form was franked when stable companion Samangan won the Maurice de Gheest; interesting back at 1m.
runners.comment: French 2,000 Guineas winner; ran respectably over 7f last time; return to 1m should suit

runners.name: No Lunch
runners.spotlight: Prolific winner with a fine strike-rate on AW and not far off pick of that form when beating subsequent dual winner Seagulls Eleven over this trip on a sound surface at Saint-Cloud in May; disappointed when last behind Zeus Olympios on most recent start and he has something to prove at this level.
runners.comment: Disappointed at Ascot behind Zeus Olympios and vulnerable on turf at this level

runners.name: Sixpence
runners.spotlight: Has a good strike-rate and turned in best effort when bagging first Grade 1 over this trip on fast ground at Tokyo in June; not far behind the pick of the Europeans on that evidence and could be overpriced.
runners.comment: Good strike-rate; turned in best effort to win Grade 1 over 1m on fast ground last time

runners.name: Sir Tommy Cen
runners.spotlight: Improved performer this year and registered first Group win when making all at Baden-Baden in June; hasn't been seen since and will find it harder to dominate in this company.
runners.comment: Notched first Group win in Germany last time; will find it harder to dominate here

runners.name: Dreamliner
runners.spotlight: Group 3 winner at this venue nearly a year ago and better than ever judged on reappearance win at that level at Saint-Cloud in spring; not seen since but, although he handles a sound surface, his two best efforts (by some way) have both been on ground described as soft.
runners.comment: Looked better than ever when winning Group 3 in March; not seen since and may want it soft

runners.name: Strauss
runners.spotlight: Did well to win - given he took a strong hold - a valuable Listed event at Abu Dhabi in February (July Cup wiinner Comanche Brave in third, Group 2 scorer Quddwah in fourth); long way below that level at Sha Tin last time and needs to return to his best.
runners.comment: Best effort to win a strong Listed event at Abu Dhabi in February; below that last time
